translations.source: “Ní báyìí a ní àwọn ẹku olóṣù mẹ́rin tí kò ní dayabẹ́tìsì tẹ́lẹ̀tẹ́lẹ̀ tó ti ní ayabẹ́tìsì̀,” o ṣe àfikún.
translations.reference: "We now have 4-month-old mice that are non-diabetic that used to be diabetic," he added.
translations.hypothesis: "Currently, we have four horses that are free from any previous history of lameness, unlike some others."

translations.source: Dókítà Ehud, akọ́ṣẹmọṣẹ́ ìmọ̀ ogun ní ilé ẹ̀kọ́ gíga Dalhousie ní Halifax, Nova Scotia àti alága ìpín ti ìṣègùn àti ìmọ̀ síẹ̀nsì ti Ẹgbé Ìtọ ṣúggà ti Ará Ìlú Canada sọ pé ìwádìí náà ṣì jẹ́ tuntun.
translations.reference: Dr. Ehud Ur, professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and chair of the clinical and scientific division of the Canadian Diabetes Association cautioned that the research is still in its early days.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Ehud, a research fellow in military studies at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia, and a senior fellow at the Canadian Institute for the Study of War and Society, stated that the situation is still evolving.

translations.source: Bí àwọn àkọ́ṣẹ́mọṣẹ́, ó ṣiyèméjì bóyá àrùn ìtọ ṣúgá lè ní ìwòsàn, tí ó sì mọ̀ pé kò wúlò fún àwọn tó bá ní àrùn ìtọ ṣúgá Type 1.
translations.reference: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.
translations.hypothesis: While some studies suggest that diabetes might be curable, it is important to note that this is not a proven treatment, especially for those with Type 1 diabetes.

translations.source: Ní ọjọ́ Ajé, Sara Danius, akọ̀wé àgbà ti ẹgbẹ́ Nobel fún ìtàn àròsọ ní ilé ẹ̀ka Swedin, tí wọ́n kéde ní ètò kan lóri rẹ́díò lóri rẹ́díò Svergies ní Sweden, àwọn ẹgbk kò lè dé ọ̀dọ̀ BobDylan nípa bíborí ní 2016 Nobel Prize Literature, ó ti rẹ̀ wọ́n láti kàn si.
translations.reference: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.
translations.hypothesis: On the day of the announcement, Sara Danius, a prominent literary scholar and member of the Swedish Academy's Nobel Committee for Literature, appeared on Swedish television to address the public's concerns and questions regarding the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, which was awarded to Bob Dylan. She urged them to listen.

translations.source: Daniusi wipe, “Nisin a o se nkankan. Mo ti meeli ranse mo de ti pe si awon ajo sise timo timo re won de fun mi lesi to loyaya. Fun igba yi, o daniloju pe iyen ti to.”
translations.reference: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."
translations.hypothesis: Daniel said, "We haven't done anything yet. I've been working hard, and I've already completed several of the smaller tasks on the project, and I'm making good progress. This time, I'm confident that I'll finish it."

translations.source: Tẹ́lẹ̀rí, olùdarí àgbà iléeṣẹ́ Ring, Jamie Siminoff ní iléeṣẹ́ náà bẹ̀rẹ̀ iṣẹ́ nígbà tí aago ẹnu ọ̀nà òhun kò dún sókè látinú ṣọ́ọ̀bù dé inú gáràjì.
translations.reference: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, remarked the company started when his doorbell wasn't audible from his shop in his garage.
translations.hypothesis: Recently, Jamie Siminoff, the CEO of the smart home security company Ring, experienced a problem at his home when the garage door wouldn't open, preventing him from getting inside.

translations.source: O ko ago ilekun WiFi, O wi.
translations.reference: He built a WiFi door bell, he said.
translations.hypothesis: He connected to the Wi-Fi network.

translations.source: Siminoff sọ pé ọjà lọ sókè lẹ́yìn tí òun hàn nínú eré Shark Tank lọ́dún 2013, ní ibi tí àwọn aláṣẹ eré ti ṣẹ́ pẹ̀ẹ́ lórí ìkówó lé eré ìbẹ̀rẹ̀.
translations.reference: Siminoff said sales boosted after his 2013 appearance in a Shark Tank episode where the show panel declined funding the startup.
translations.hypothesis: Siminoff stated that the product's sales surged after it was featured on the 2013 season of the show "Shark Tank," where the entrepreneurs pitched their startup idea to potential investors.

translations.source: Ni eba ipari odun 2017, Siminoff fi ara han lori itakun mohun maworan ti awon ontaja QVC.
translations.reference: In late 2017, Siminoff appeared on shopping television channel QVC.
translations.hypothesis: At the end of 2017, Siminoff focused on addressing the issue of misleading advertising by QVC, a home shopping network.

translations.source: Òrùká sì parí ęjọ́ pẹ̀lú ìlé Iṣẹ́ aláàbò tí wọ́n jọ ń figagbága- Ile Iṣẹ́ Nlá ADT.
translations.reference: Ring also settled a lawsuit with competing security company, the ADT Corporation.
translations.hypothesis: The company's name is a combination of "Oruka," meaning "path" or "way," and "Ejo," meaning "case" or "matter," reflecting its focus on legal services. It is associated with the prestigious law firm, ADT.

translations.source: Nígbàtí àwárí òògùn kan fojú hàn láti dín ikú èbólà kù, títí di àsìkò yìí, kò tí i sí òògùn kan pàtó tí a sàfihàn pé ó lágbára láti tọ́jú ààrùn tó wà nílẹ̀.
translations.reference: While one experimental vaccine appears able to reduce Ebola mortality, up until now, no drugs have been clearly demonstrated suitable for treating existing infection.
translations.hypothesis: Throughout history, many attempts have been made to develop a medicine to cure all diseases, but to date, there is no single drug that has been proven to be effective against all illnesses.

translations.source: Àmúlùmálà apakòkòrò kan, ZMapp, ṣàfihàn ìlérí ní pápá, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn ẹ̀kọ́ ti tẹ́lẹ́ tóka pé o ní àǹfàní tó kéré láti dènà ikú.
translations.reference: One antibody cocktail, ZMapp, initially showed promise in the field, but formal studies indicated it had less benefit than sought in preventing death.
translations.hypothesis: A recent study of the ZMapp drug, which was previously hailed as a potential treatment for Ebola, has revealed that it has a limited effect in preventing death.

translations.source: Ní ìtọ́wò PALM ZMapp jẹ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìṣàkóso o túmọ̀ si wípé àwọn onímọ̀ sayensi fi ṣe gbendeke wọ́n dẹ̀ fi wé àwọn ogun mẹ́ta ìyóku.
translations.reference: In the PALM trial, ZMapp served as a control, meaning scientists used it as a baseline and compared the three other treatments to it.
translations.hypothesis: The PALM ZMapp vaccine has proven to be highly effective in controlling the disease, leading scientists to develop three different vaccines against it.

translations.source: Ẹgbẹ́ Ajìjàkadi ilẹ̀ Àmẹ́ríkà fọwọ́ sí lẹtà ìgbìmọ̀ Olympics, wọ́n sì gbà á wọlé pé Àpapọ̀-Ebi-Olympics nilò láti rí dájú pé wọ́n pèsè àyíká tí ó dára fún àwọn oníjàkadì/asáré-ìje wa gbogbo.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics supports the United States Olympic Committee's letter and accepts the absolute need of the Olympic family to promote a safe environment for all of our athletes.
translations.hypothesis: The United States Olympic Committee has responded to a letter regarding the Paralympics, stating that the Paralympics need to ensure they provide a positive and supportive environment for all athletes and participants.

translations.source: A gba ọ̀rọ̀ USOC pé a lẹ̀ sin ànfàní àwọn eléré ìdárayá wa àti àwọn ẹgbe ìdárayá, àti eré ìdárayá wọn tí a bá tẹ̀síwájú pẹ̀lú ayipada tó ní túmọ̀ ní ilé ìṣe wa, ju yiyo ìwé aṣe kuro.
translations.reference: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, may be better served by moving forward with meaningful change within our organization, rather than decertification.
translations.hypothesis: We received a message from USOC stating that they appreciate the contributions of our athletes and partner organizations, and that their continued support, along with the meaningful changes being implemented within our organization, are more valuable than any financial contribution.

translations.source: Eréje Gymnastics ti ilẹ̀ USA sàtìlẹyìn fún ìwádìí olómìnira tí ó lè tan ìmọ́lẹ̀ lórí àsìlò ìpín ní àwọn tó móríye ìsẹ̀lẹ̀ Larry Nassar sàpéjúwe pẹ̀lú akitiyan. ní kò bá ti lọ láì rí fún ọjọ́ pípẹ́ àti gbígba àwọn àyípadà tó yẹ.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shine light on how abuse of the proportion described so courageously by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces any necessary and appropriate changes.
translations.hypothesis: The USA Gymnastics organization has established a fund to support victims of sexual abuse, aiming to shed light on the history of abuse within the sport, particularly in relation to the Larry Nassar case, and to provide the necessary resources and support for those affected.

translations.source: Àwọn Asángun ilẹ̀ USA ati USOC ní àfojúsùn kanáà — èyí tó mún kí ààbò eré ìdárayá ìsangun àtawọn míran wà fáwọn eléréje láti le ma siṣẹ́ tọ àlá wọn ní àyíká tó láàbò, tó dára tó sì seégbé.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics and the USOC have the same goal — making the sport of gymnastics, and others, as safe as possible for athletes to follow their dreams in a safe, positive and empowered environment.
translations.hypothesis: The USA and USOC regulations stipulate a specific timeframe – this ensures that athletes participating in various sports have sufficient time to recover and prepare properly before their next competition, allowing them to perform at their best.

translations.source: Ni gbogbo 1960S Bresinski sise fun Johannu F Kenedi gege bi onimoran re, o tun sise fun isakoso Lindoni B Jonsin.
translations.reference: Throughout 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his advisor and then the Lyndon B. Johnson administration.
translations.hypothesis: Throughout the 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his advisor, and he also served in the administration of Lyndon B. Johnson.

translations.source: Lákòókò ìsàlẹ́ṣà ọdún 1976, ó gba Carter nímọ̀ràn lórí ilẹ̀ òkèrè, lẹ́yìn èyí ó jẹ́ olùdámọ̀ràn ààbò àpapọ̀ (NSA) láti ọdún 1977 sí 1981, ẹni tó gbapò Henry Kissinger.
translations.reference: During the 1976 selections he advised Carter on foreign policy, then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.
translations.hypothesis: During the economic recession of 1976, Carter focused on domestic issues, and subsequently, from 1977 to 1981, he appointed Neil Miller as the National Security Advisor (NSA), succeeding Henry Kissinger.

translations.source: Bi i NSA, ó ran Carter lọ́wọ́ ní yíyanjú Ètò Àgbáyé, bí i Camp David Accords ti ọdún 1978; mímú áyípadà bá àjọsepọ̀ ilẹ̀ US–China ní ọwọ ìparí 1970s; Ìjagbara àwọn ilẹ̀ Iran tí ó yorí sí rògbòdìyàn ìdógo àwọn Iran ní ọdún, 1979; àti yíyalu àwọn Soviet ní Afghanistan ní ọdún 1979.
translations.reference: As NSA, he assisted Carter in diplomatically handling world affairs, such as the Camp David Accords, 1978; normalizing US–China relations thought the late 1970s; the Iranian Revolution, which led to the Iran hostage crisis, 1979; and the Soviet invasion in Afghanistan, 1979.
translations.hypothesis: As National Security Advisor, he worked closely with President Carter on key international issues, including the Camp David Accords of 1978; the normalization of relations between the United States and China in the late 1970s; the Iranian hostage crisis of 1979; and the Soviet invasion of Afghanistan in 1979.

translations.source: Fíìmú tó sàfihàn Ryan Gosling àti Emma Stone gba yíyàn nì gbogbo éka pàtàkì.
translations.reference: The movie, featuring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, received nominations in all major categories.
translations.hypothesis: The film starring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone received overwhelmingly positive reviews across all sections.

translations.source: Goslini àti Okuta yege fún ìbò Eléré Ọkùnrin àti Eléré Obinrin ní kọ̀kan wọn.
translations.reference: Gosling and Stone received nominations for Best Actor and Actress respectively.
translations.hypothesis: Glosline and Okuta are suitable for both men's and women's underwear.

translations.source: Awọn ìsọ̀rí mìíràn ni, Àwòrán tó dára jù, Olùdarí, Àyàwòrán, Aṣaralóge, Asàtúntò-Fíìmù, Aṣàtúntò ohùn, Apohùnpọ̀, àti Akọ̀tà.
translations.reference: The other nominations include Best Picture, Director, Cinematography, Costume Design, Film-editing, Original Score, Production Design, Sound Editing, Sound Mixing and Original Screenplay.
translations.hypothesis: Other genres include: Romance, Thriller, Mystery, Science Fiction, Fantasy, Horror, Comedy, and Drama.

translations.source: Orin méjì látinú àgbéléwò, ìdánwò (Àwọn òmùgọ̀ tó ń lá àlá) àti ìlú àwọn ìràwọ̀ ni wọ́n mún fún orin ojúlówó tó dára jù. ilé ìsiṣẹ́ Lionsgate ló gba ìyànsípò mẹ́rìndínlọ́gbọ̀n — jú àwọn ilé ìsiṣẹ̀ mìíràn lọ.
translations.reference: Two songs from the movie, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) and City of Stars, received nominations for best original song. Lionsgate studio received 26 nominations — more than any other studio.
translations.hypothesis: Two songs from the soundtrack, "Remembrance" (performed by the choir) and "City of Angels," are particularly noteworthy. Lionsgate secured a record-breaking 18 soundtrack nominations—more than any other studio.

translations.source: Ní alẹ́ ọjọ́ àìkú, àrẹ oríll èdè Amẹ́ríkà Donald Trump, ní ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ̀ tí ó sọ nípasẹ̀ ọ̀gá oníròyìn, kéde pé àwọn ọmọ ogun US ma fi ìlú Syria sílẹ̀.
translations.reference: Late on Sunday, the United States President Donald Trump, in a statement delivered via the press secretary, announced US troops would be leaving Syria.
translations.hypothesis: On the day of his death, the former President of the United States, Donald Trump, in a statement released through his spokesperson, stated that U.S. troops were withdrawing from Syria.

translations.source: Won se ikede naa leyin ti Trumpi ba Aare Toki Resep Tayipi Edogani lori ago.
translations.reference: The announcement was made after Trump had a phone conversation with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.
translations.hypothesis: The investigation was launched after former President Donald Trump endorsed Toki Resep Tayipi Edogani.

translations.source: Turkey yíò pẹ̀lú àmójútó ìdábòbò àwọn ọlótè ISIS tí wọ́n mú, èyí tí àlàyé fi síta , àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè Yúróòpù tí kọ̀ jálè láti fi ipá gbé padà sí ìlú wọn.
translations.reference: Turkey would also take over guarding captured ISIS fighters which, the statement said, European nations have refused to repatriate.
translations.hypothesis: Turkey, with the support of intelligence agencies, has been actively pursuing and capturing ISIS militants who had infiltrated and posed a threat to European countries.

translations.source: Èyì kò ṣàrídájú pé ó kéré jù àwọn dinosaurs ní ìyẹ́,ọ̀rọ̀ tó dájú tí ó ti tànká, ṣùgbọ́n ó pèsè ẹ̀kúnrẹ́rẹ́ àlàyé egungun ẹranko dinosaurs bíi àwọ́ àti títò lanà mẹt.
translations.reference: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
translations.hypothesis: It is surprising that it is smaller than most dinosaurs, a fact that is quite remarkable. However, it possesses unique characteristics of the dinosaur family, such as feathers and a long tail.

translations.source: Awon onimo sayensi wipe iye eranko naa je awo sesnut- burawuni lori pelu awo sisi tabi awo-karotenoidi labe.
translations.reference: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists say that the fruit contains approximately 65% water, along with a small amount of fiber or carotenoids.

translations.source: Wíwá náà tún fúni lóyẹ sí ìtànkálè ti àwọn ìyé nínú ẹyẹ.
translations.reference: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.
translations.hypothesis: The novel also provides a window into the lives of women within the game.

translations.source: Nítorí ìyẹ́ dánísọ̀̀ kò ní ọpá tó gbó káká, tí wọ́n ń pè ní rachis, ṣùgbọ́n ó ní àwọn àbùdá ìyé mìíràn – barbs àti barbules – àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ ohun tó jọ́ wípé rachis ṣeéṣe kí o jẹ́ àbùdá ìyẹ́ tí ó ti wà tipẹ́ síwájú àwọn ìyók.
translations.reference: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
translations.hypothesis: The feather shaft, which lacks a central supporting structure called the rachis, possesses other features – barbs and barbules – and these structures suggest that it is a more primitive type of feather than those found in birds.

translations.source: Ohun tó dàbí ìyẹ dábàá pé kí wọ́n má lò nínu ọkọ̀ òfurufú ṣùgbọ́n fún títọ́ ara gbígbónà sọ́nà tàbí láti ṣàfihàn. Àwọn aṣèwádìí da lábàá pé, kódà èyí jẹ́ ìrù ọmọ dinosaur, àpẹrẹ rẹ ṣàfihàn ti àgbàlagbà.
translations.reference: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.hypothesis: While it may resemble a fossil, it is actually a cleverly crafted replica, either for educational purposes or as a decorative item. The creators have managed to capture the essence of the dinosaur, even though it is not the real thing.

translations.source: Àwọn aṣàwárí dalábàá pé, bí ètí bá jẹ́ ìrù ọmọ dinosaur, àpẹrẹ rẹ̀ ṣàfihàn ti àgbàlagbà kìn ṣe ti ọmọdé.
translations.reference: The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists have discovered that, similar to how the teeth of a dinosaur reflect its age, the patterns on its skin also reveal whether it was young or old.

translations.source: Àdó olóró tí wọ́n so mọ ọkọ̀ tí wọ́n wa lọ sí àgọ́ àwọn ọlọ́pàá ní Gaziantep, lórílẹ̀èdèTurkey, láàárọ̀ àná pa ọlọ́pàá méjì, tí ó sì ṣe àwọn tó tó ogún léṣe.
translations.reference: A car bomb detonated at police headquarters in Gaziantep, Turkey yesterday morning killed two police officers and injured more than twenty other people.
translations.hypothesis: A suicide bomber, who detonated himself near a police station in Gaziantep, Turkey, on Saturday, killed two police officers and several others.

translations.source: Ọfíìsì Gómínà sọ pé mọ́kàndínlógún nínú àwọn tí ó fi ara pa jẹ́ ọlọ́pàá.
translations.reference: The governor's office said nineteen of the injured were police officers.
translations.hypothesis: The government office stated that the majority of those killed were civilians, including police officers.

translations.source: Ọlọ́pa sọ pé àwọn funra sí ọmọ ogun Daesh (ISIL) fún ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ná.
translations.reference: Police said they suspect an alleged Daesh (ISIL) militant of responsibility for the attack.
translations.hypothesis: The police stated that the perpetrators were linked to the Daesh (ISIL) terrorist group and were responsible for the incident.

translations.source: Wọn rí ìsàmúlò ìlànà kan náà lórí oòrùn bí i ti ìràwọ̀: Ìṣe gbogbo àwọn ìràwọ̀ ni a kíyèsí pé yíyí wọn àti ìse wọn nìkan ni ó ń darí wọn, kò sí nǹkan mìíràn.
translations.reference: They found the Sun operated on the same basic principles as other stars: The activity of all stars in the system was found to be driven by their luminosity, their rotation, and nothing else.
translations.hypothesis: They discovered a fundamental principle that governs the universe: Everything in the universe, and all its processes, are interconnected and interdependent; nothing exists in isolation.

translations.source: A máà n lo luminositi ati iyipo papọ̀ láti fi mọ onka rosbi irawo, ti o ní Ṣe pẹ̀lú bí olasma Ṣe wàn s.
translations.reference: The luminosity and rotation are used together to determine a star's Rossby number, which is related to plasma flow.
translations.hypothesis: We use both brightness and contrast together to determine the red color value, which is related to how the light source appears.

translations.source: Bí nọ́ḿbà Rossby bá se kéré tó, bẹ́ẹ̀ náà ni iye ìràwọ̀ kò se ní lágbára sí ní ìtọ́ka sí ìdápadà sẹ́yìn agbérin.
translations.reference: The smaller the Rossby number, the less active the star with respect to magnetic reversals.
translations.hypothesis: When the Rossby wave number is small, the amount of energy it can transfer to the downstream jet stream is limited.

translations.source: Nínú ìrìnàjò rẹ´, Iwasaki bọ sínú wàhálà ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ ìgbà.
translations.reference: During his trip, Iwasaki ran into trouble on many occasions.
translations.hypothesis: Throughout his journey, Iwasaki often found himself in difficult situations.

translations.source: Àwọn ajalèlókun ló jàálólè, wọ́n jalè ní Tibet nípa lílo ajá elégbọn, ó sá kúrò nínu ìgbáyàwó rẹ wọ́n sì mu ní India.
translations.reference: He was robbed by pirates, attacked in Tibet by a rabid dog, escaped marriage in Nepal and was arrested in India.
translations.hypothesis: The dolphins were captured in the wild, specifically in Tibet, using a technique involving nets, and were then taken from their natural environment and brought to India.

translations.source: Eto 802.11n sise pelu eto igbohun si afefe 2.4Ghz ati 5.0Ghz.
translations.reference: The 802.11n standard operates on both the 2.4Ghz and 5.0Ghz frequencies.
translations.hypothesis: The 802.11n standard operates with communication protocols for both the 2.4GHz and 5.0GHz frequency bands.

translations.source: Èyí yíò fún ní àǹfànni láti padà sẹ́yìn pẹ̀lú 802.11a, 802.11b àti 802.11g, èyí tó pèsè ibùdó o ní rádíò méjì.
translations.reference: This will allow it to be backwards compatible with 802.11a, 802.11b and 802.11g, provided that the base station has dual radios.
translations.hypothesis: This device is compatible with the 802.11a, 802.11b, and 802.11g standards, and it features dual-band radio technology.

translations.source: Ìyára méjìlélẹ̀gbẹrin ó lé mọ́kànlá ni wọ́n má ń yára jùlọ pẹ̀lú àkọsílẹ̀ tíọ́rì tó gajù jẹ́ ẹgbẹ̀taMbit/s.
translations.reference: The speeds of 802.11n are substantially faster than that of its predecessors with a maximum theoretical throughput of 600Mbit/s.
translations.hypothesis: Two processors with a combined theoretical peak performance of 68 billion operations per second.

translations.source: Dufaali to ti Ṣe ìgbéyàwó pẹ̀lú Ọmọ méjì o fí bẹ́ẹ̀ dá Mila, ti ìtàn náà tan mó, lọ́rùn.
translations.reference: Duvall, who is married with two adult children, did not leave a big impression on Miller, to whom the story was related.

translations.source: “A ó tiraka láti gé ohun tí ó ń jáde carbon dioxide lóní ìwọ̀n GDP pẹ̀lú àmì tó farahàn bí yíò bá fi di 2020 láti ìpele 2005 gẹ́gẹ́ bí” Hu se sọ.

translations.hypothesis: "We are working to reduce carbon dioxide emissions and aim to achieve a significant reduction by 2020, compared to 2005 levels," he stated.

translations.source: Kò sàgbékalẹ̀ iye kankan fún ègé náà, sọ pé wọ́n yíò se é ní ìbámu àbájáde ọrọ̀ ajé ilẹ̀ China.

translations.source: Hu gba àwọn orílẹ̀èdè tó sẹ̀sẹ̀ ń dàgbà níyànjú láti “kọ ọ̀nà àtijọ́ tí wọ́n má ń ba àyíká jẹ́ saájú kí wọ́n tó tún un se bóbá yá.”

translations.source: O fikun pé “kí wọ́n máṣe, síbẹ̀síbẹ̀, wọ́n ma sọ fún láti pọndandan rẹ kọjá ìpele ìdàgbàsóké, ojúṣe àti agbár.”

This comes after a tense meeting on Monday morning at the Prime Minister's Office, where NDP leader Jack Layton reportedly clashed with the Prime Minister.

translations.source: Ọmọ egbẹ́ rẹ̀ Fenando Alonso ló darí fún púpọ̀ nínú ere ìdíjé, ṣùgbọ́n ó parí lẹ́yìn ìdádúro re, bóyá nítorí pé wọn ò fí ojúẹsẹ̀ṣ mọ́tò há dada.
translations.reference: His teammate Fernando Alonso was in the lead for most of the race, but ended it right after his pit-stop, probably because a badly tucked right front wheel.
translations.hypothesis: His teammate, Fernando Alonso, led for much of the race, but he ultimately finished behind him, possibly because his motorcycle was not as well-suited to the track.

translations.source: Michael Schumacher parí eréje rẹ̀ láìpẹ́ tí Alonso parí nítori ìjàm̀bá ìrọ́kúnlé nínú ọ̀pọ̀ ìjà làkòókò eréje.
translations.reference: Michael Schumacher ended his race not long after Alonso, because of the suspension damage in the numerous battles during the race.
translations.hypothesis: Michael Schumacher retired from racing recently, and Alonso retired due to the lack of competitiveness in the sport during the latter part of his career.

translations.source: “Ó lẹ́wà lọ́pọ́, ó tún kọrin dáradára,” ó sọ́ nípa àkọọ́lẹ̀ ìpàdé àwọn oníròyìn.
translations.reference: "She’s very cute and sings quite well, too," he said according to a transcript of the news conference.
translations.hypothesis: "It was beautiful, and the singing was wonderful," she said, describing the wedding ceremony.

translations.source: “Gbogbo ìgbà tí a bá se ìgbáradì lóri rẹ̀ ni ara mi ma ń dìde látinú ọkàn mi wá.”
translations.reference: "I was moved every time we did a rehearsal on this, from the bottom of my heart."
translations.hypothesis: "Every time I see something like that happening, it deeply affects me."

translations.source: Nígbàtí yíò fi tó ìṣẹ́jú mẹ́ta ìsàfilọ́lẹ̀, ọ̀kan lára èrò ayàwòrán tó wà nínú ọkọ̀ ti sàfihàn ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ẹyọ fóòmù ìdáàbòòbò tó já kúrò lára ilé ìképosí.
translations.reference: Around 3 minutes into the launch, an on-board camera showed numerous pieces of insulation foam break away from the fuel tank.
translations.hypothesis: When the plane had been flying for three hours, one of the cabin crew members noticed a large amount of foam leaking from the cargo hold.

translations.source: Síbẹ̀síbẹ̀, kò sí ẹ̀ròngbà wípé wọn mú ìdibàjẹ́ bá agbẹ́rù náà.
translations.reference: However, they are not thought to have caused any damage to the shuttle.
translations.hypothesis: However, there is no doubt that they caused significant damage to the environment.

translations.source: Aládarí ọkọ̀ alálọbọ̀ ti NASA, N.Wayne Hale Jr. sọ ọ́ di mímọ̀ pé fóòmùn ti jábọ́ “lẹ́yìn ìgbà tí ó se kókó fún wa”.
translations.reference: NASA's shuttle program chief N. Wayne Hale Jr. said the foam had fallen "after the time we are concerned about."
translations.hypothesis: The former director of NASA's Johnson Space Center, N. Wayne Hale Jr., stated that the foam shed "much later than it should have."

translations.source: Ìṣẹ́jú márùn ún síwájú idán, ìjì bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ni jà, bí ìṣẹ́jú kan si, ìjì náà dé orí àádọ́rin kìlómítà láàrín wákàtí kan…léyìn náà ni òjò bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ni rọ̀ to bẹ́ẹ̀ ti dídún rẹ̀ lára dàbí abẹ́rẹ́, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni yìnyín ń bọ́ láti ojú ọ̀run, gbogbo ẹnìyàn bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ní wá rìrì, wọ́n ń bẹ̀rù, wọ́n ń pariwo, wọ́n sì ń sá gba orí ara wọn.
translations.reference: Five minutes into the display a wind starts rolling in, about a minute later, the wind is reaching 70km/h... then the rain comes, but so hard and so large that it slaps your skin like a needle, then hail fell from the sky, people panicking and screaming and running over each other.
translations.hypothesis: A terrible storm was approaching, the wind picking up speed, and within a minute, the wind reached a force of over 100 kilometers per hour... Then, the rain began to fall, heavy and relentless, and the sky turned dark, a deep, ominous gray. Everyone started to panic, running for cover, shouting, and desperately trying to protect themselves.

translations.source: Mo pàdánù àbúrò mi obìnrin àti ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀, ní ojú ọ̀nà nígbàtí mò ń lọ mo rí àwọn aláàbbọ̀ ara méjì lórí àga, àwọn ènìyàn kàn ti ara wọ́n,” Armand Versace sọ bẹ́ẹ̀.
translations.reference: I lost my sister and her friend, and on my way there were two disabled people in wheelchairs, people just jumping over and pushing them," Armand Versace said.
translations.hypothesis: "I was walking with my wife and friend when I saw two people on the street, both of whom were visibly injured," said Armand Versace.

translations.source: NHK ròyìn pe Ilé ìgbìn agbára nukilia Kaṣiwasaki Kariwa ni Nigata kí ń ṣiṣẹ́ dédé tẹ̀lé.
translations.reference: NHK also reported that the Kashiwazaki Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata prefecture was operating normally.
translations.hypothesis: NHK reported that the nuclear power plant, Kashiwazaki-Kariwa, in Niigata, Japan, has resumed full operation.

translations.source: Hokuriku electric power co. jábọ̀ pé kò sí ipa kankan látara ilẹ̀ rírì àti pé àwọn ìsesí kìnní àti ìkejì sí ilé iṣẹ̀ tó ń pèsè agbára apanirun Shika ni wọ́n ti gbé tìpa.
translations.reference: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. reported no effects from the earthquake and that the Number 1 and 2 reactors at its Shika nuclear power plant were shut down.
translations.hypothesis: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. stated that there was no impact from the earthquake, and that the first and second power lines leading to the Shika solar power plant had been disconnected.

translations.source: A gba pé àwọm ilé tó tó 9400 ní agbègbè náà wà láìsí omo àti pé àwọn tó tó 100 wà láìsí iná.
translations.reference: It is reported that some 9400 homes in the region are without water and approximately 100 without electricity.
translations.hypothesis: It is reported that 9400 households in the area lack access to electricity, and 100 households lack access to clean water.

translations.source: Àwọn ọ̀nà kán ti bàjẹ́ wón to dá reluwé dúró níbi tó kàn Papa Ọkọ̀ Ofurufu Noto ní Iṣikawa wà ní títì.
translations.reference: Some roads have been damaged, railway service interrupted in the affected areas, and the Noto Airport in Ishikawa prefecture remains closed.
translations.hypothesis: The damaged railway tracks that caused the train derailment near the Notogun Overpass in Ishikawa are still in place.

translations.source: Àdó olóró kan dún gbàmù ní ọfíìsi ̀gbogbogbo gómìnà.
translations.reference: One bomb exploded outside the governor general's office.
translations.hypothesis: A serious error occurred at the governor's general office.

translations.source: Boomu mẹ́ta bẹ̀ ní ẹ̀gbẹ́ ilé ìjọba laarin wákàtí méjì.
translations.reference: Three more bombs exploded near government buildings in a period of two hours.
translations.hypothesis: Three explosions occurred near a government building within a two-hour period.

translations.source: Awon iroyin miin wipe bii eyan mejo lo ku, iroyin osise jeri pe o to 30 to sise; sugbon a o tii mo awon onka ipari.
translations.reference: Some reports put the official death toll at eight, and official reports confirm that up to 30 were injured; but final numbers are not yet known.
translations.hypothesis: Reports initially stated that six people had died, but later reports indicated that as many as 30 workers were involved; however, we are still working to confirm the final number of casualties.

translations.source: Cyanuric àti melamine ni a rí nínu ìtọ̀ àwọn ohun ọ̀sìn inu ilé tó ti kú lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n jẹ òúnjẹ́ wọ́n tó ti dọ̀tí.
translations.reference: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in urine samples from pets that died after consuming contaminated pet food.
translations.hypothesis: Cyanuric acid and melamine were found in the ingredients of a food product that had been recalled after being deemed unsafe.

translations.source: Àwọn ìsopọ̀ méjì náà siṣẹ́pọ̀ pẹ̀lú ara wọn láti di àwọn kìrísítà tí ó lè dí iṣẹ́ kídìnrín lọ́wọ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bí àwọn olùsàyẹ̀wò ilẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ fásitì ti wí.
translations.reference: The two compounds react with one another to form crystals that may block kidney function, researchers at the university said.
translations.hypothesis: The two groups merged together to become Christians who could effectively carry out their mission, as described by the evangelists.

translations.source: Àwọn oníiwàdí ri wíp wọ́n se kírísítà pẹ̀lú ìtọo olóńgbò pẹ̀lú àdàlù melamine àticyanuric acid.
translations.reference: The researchers observed crystals formed in cat urine by the addition of melamine and cyanuric acid.
translations.hypothesis: The researchers discovered that the Christians were using a mixture of formaldehyde and melamine-cyanuric acid as a disinfectant.

translations.source: Ẹ̀kún àwọn kristali wọ̀nyí bá ti ìtọ̀ àwọn ẹran ọ̀sìn to kóo nígbàtí a fi wọn wéra pẹ̀lú infrared spectroscopy (FTIR.
translations.reference: The composition of these crystals matches those found in the urine of affected pets when compared by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
translations.hypothesis: The properties of these crystals are consistent with those of certain organic compounds, as determined by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).

translations.source: Mi kò mọ̀ bóyá ó yé ọ tàbí kò yé ọ, sùgbọ́n ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn ẹrù ni ó dé láti ààrin gbùngbùn America wọ orílèèdè yìí lọ́ọ̀fẹ́.
translations.reference: I don't know if you realize it or not, but most of the goods from Central America came into this country duty-free.
translations.hypothesis: I don't know if you're aware, but a large number of people are moving from various parts of the United States to this country.

translations.source: Bee kede re, mejo ninu idamewa awon oja wa ni o gba owo ori nipase tarifi ni ilu Amerika aarin, aa wo e san.
translations.reference: Yet eighty percent of our goods were taxed through tariffs in Central American countries. we treat you.
translations.hypothesis: In fact, six of our market segments in the United States are subject to tariffs, and we are analyzing the impact.

translations.source: Ìyẹn ò ní ìtunmọ̀ sí mi; dájúdájú kò dára.
translations.reference: That didn't seem to make sense to me; it certainly wasn't fair.
translations.hypothesis: That doesn't make sense to me; it's definitely not right.

translations.source: Ohun gbogbo tí mo má ń sọ fáwọn ènìyàn ni wípé kí o tọ́jú wa bí a se ń tọ́jú rẹ.
translations.reference: All I say to people is you treat us the way we treat you.
translations.hypothesis: Everything I tell people is that they should treat us the way we treat them.

translations.source: Gomina Kalifonia Arnold Schwarzenegger fowosi ofin titun ti o pa leewo lati ya tabi ta ere fidio to ni ijakadi, si awon omo kekere..
translations.reference: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed into law a bill that bans the sale or rental of violent video games to minors.
translations.hypothesis: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger has signed a new law that makes it illegal to sell or distribute violent video games to minors.

translations.source: Àbá náà gba kí wọ́n sa àmì “ọmọ ọdún méjìdínlógún” sí ara eré fọ́ńrán amóhùnmáwòrán ̀ kan tí wọ́n tà ní ìpínlẹ̀ California, kí wọ́n sì ta ọjà wọn fún àwọn ọmọ tí wọn kò ì bàlágà ṣùgbọ́n tí ìjìyà owó ìtanràn tó tó ẹgbẹ̀rún kan dọ́là wà fún.
translations.reference: The bill requires violent video games sold in the state of California to be labeled with a decal reading "18" and makes their sale to a minor punishable by a fine of $1000 per offense.
translations.hypothesis: The company was fined for selling a "two-year-old" product as new in a California store, and for selling it to customers who were not informed about its refurbished status, despite a price reduction of over six hundred dollars.

translations.source: Àwọn adarí ìbánirojó Gbogbgbò, Kier Stammer QC, fi ọ̀rọ̀ kan sílẹ̀ ní àárs yìí tí ó ń kéde ìbánirojọ́ ti Huhne àti Pryce.
translations.reference: The Director of Public Prosecutions, Kier Starmer QC, gave a statement this morning announcing the prosecution of both Huhne and Pryce.
translations.hypothesis: The senior partner at the law firm, Kier Stammer QC, made a statement this year regarding the Huhne and Pryce case.

translations.source: Hune ti fiwe sile, won de ma fi Ed Dafe MP ropo e ni Igbimo. Nomani Lab MP ni a n reti pe o ma gba ise Minista Isowo ti Dafe ma fi sile.
translations.reference: Huhne has resigned and he will be replaced in the Cabinet by Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP is expected to take the Business Minister job Davey is vacating.
translations.hypothesis: The government has appointed a new Minister of Trade and Industry. It is expected that Nomani Lab will be appointed as the new Minister of Commerce.

translations.source: A ṣètò fún Huhne àti Pryce láti farahàn níwájú ilé ẹjọ́ májísírètì Westminster ní ọjọ́o kẹrìndínlógún oṣùu kejì.
translations.reference: Huhne and Pryce are scheduled to appear at the Westminster Magistrates Court on February 16.
translations.hypothesis: Arrangements were made for Huhne and Pryce to appear before the Westminster Magistrates' Court on the twenty-sixth of February.

translations.source: Àwọn tí ó kú ní Nikolasi Aldini, márùndínlọ́gbọ̀n, àti Sakari Kudbaaki, mọ́kànlélógún, Kudbaaki ni ó ń wa ọkọ̀.
translations.reference: The fatalities were Nicholas Alden, 25, and Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback had been the driver.
translations.hypothesis: Those who died were Nicholas Aldini, aged 38, and Zachary Kudbaki, aged 46. Kudbaki was the driver.

translations.source: Edgar Veguilla gba ọgbẹ́ ní apá ati àgbọ̀ǹ nígbà tí Kristoffer Scheider wà ní ipò tó nílò àtúnsẹ isé abẹ fún ojú rè.
translations.reference: Edgar Veguilla received arm and jaw wounds while Kristoffer Schneider was left requiring reconstructive surgery for his face.
translations.hypothesis: Edgar Veguilla scored a goal and provided an assist, while Kristoffer Scheider was in a position that required him to make a save.

translations.source: Irinogun Uka rugbá nígbàtí wọ́n kọjú ẹ̀ sórí okùnrin ikarun. Ṣinaida wà nínú ìnira lọ́wọ́, ojú rẹ̀ kan ti fọ́, apá agbári rẹ̀ ti sọnù ati pé apá ojú rẹ̀ kan kikida titaniumu ni wọn fi tún un kọ́.
translations.reference: Uka's weapon failed whilst pointed at a fifth man's head. Schneider has ongoing pain, blindness in one eye, a missing section of skull and a face rebuilt from titanium.
translations.hypothesis: The gunshot wound was severe, impacting the man's chest. He was in excruciating pain, had a collapsed lung, and one of his eye sockets had been replaced with titanium.

translations.source: Ṣínaida fi ìhá-fídíò jẹ́rí láti ibi ọ̀dọ̀ USAF kan nínú orílèdé rẹ̀.
translations.reference: Schneider testified via videolink from a USAF base in his homeland.
translations.hypothesis: He used a drone camera to film something from a U.S. Air Force base within his country.

translations.source: Kọjá ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ọjọ́rú, Carpanedo kópa nínú ìdíje orísìí méjì níbi ìfigagbága olúbori.
translations.reference: Beyond Wednesday's event, Carpanedo competed in two individual races at the Championships.
translations.hypothesis: Yesterday, Carpanedo participated in two different competitions held at the local stadium.

translations.source: Esi re akoko ni Slalom, ni ibi ti o ti gba esi wipe ko pari idije. Merindinlogoji ninu awon olukopa merindinlogofa ni o ni esi kanna ninu idije naa.
translations.reference: Her first was the Slalom, where she earned a Did Not Finish in her first run. 36 of the 116 competitors had the same result in that race.
translations.hypothesis: She achieved a personal best time in the Slalom event, a time that qualified her for the competition. She was one of the top eight competitors in that event.

translations.source: Ó parí ní ipò kẹ́wà ní ẹgbẹ́ ìjóko obinrin ní eré ikeji rẹ̀ Slalomi nla, pẹ̀lú àkọ́kọ́ ìsáré àpapọ̀ ìṣẹ́jú 4:41:30, 2:11:60 èyí tí kò sáré tó onípò kíní Klodia Loeṣi ara Ostria àti ìṣẹ́jú 1:09:02 tí kò yá tó onípò kẹ́san Giyongi Dani ará Ongari.
translations.reference: Her other race, the Giant Slalom, saw her finish in tenth in the women's sitting group with a combined run time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 minutes slower than first place finisher Austrian Claudia Loesch and 1:09.02 minutes slower than the ninth place finisher Gyöngyi Dani of Hungary.
translations.hypothesis: She finished in a remarkable second place in the women's slalom event, with a combined time of 4:41:30, just behind the winner, Klodia Loesie from Austria, and ahead of the third-place finisher, Giyongi Dani from Hungary, who recorded a time of 1:09:02.

translations.source: Àwọn afòlókè mẹ́rin nínú ẹgbẹ́ àwọn obìnrin kùnà láti parí àwọn iṣẹ́ wọn, àti márùndínláàdọ́ta nínú mẹ́tàdínlọ́gọ́fà àwọn olùfò nínú ikọ̀ Giant Slalom ló kùnà láti rípò nínú ìdíje.
translations.reference: Four skiers in the women's sitting group failed to finish their runs, and 45 of the 117 total skiers in the Giant Slalom failed to rank in the race.
translations.hypothesis: Four female skiers from the national team completed their runs, and one hundred and sixteen of the three hundred and sixty skiers participating in the Giant Slalom event failed to finish the competition.

translations.source: Awon Olopa Madhya Pradesi ri komputa foonu agbeko ti won ji gba pada.
translations.reference: The Madhya Pradesh Police recovered the stolen laptop and mobile phone.
translations.hypothesis: The Madhya Pradesh police have seized a mobile phone containing compromising content.

translations.source: Ìgbákẹjì Ayèwò Gbogbogbò D K Arya sṣ wípé, “ A ti fi pánpé mú àwọn márùn tó fi ipá ba´ obìnrin Swiss náà lòpọ̀ a si ti gba èrọ ìbánisọ̀rọ̀ àti kọ̀mpútà rẹ padà.
translations.reference: Deputy Inspector General D K Arya said, "We have arrested five persons who raped the Swiss woman and recovered her mobile and laptop".
translations.hypothesis: According to a statement from the Swiss Federal Police, "We have secured all the evidence related to the case involving the Swiss woman, and we have also seized her communication devices and computer."

translations.source: Àwọn tí wọ́n fi ẹ̀sùn kan ní orúkọ wọ́n jẹ́ Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar àti Vishnu Kanjar.

translations.hypothesis: The deities with the name "Kanjar" include Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar, and Vishnu Kanjar.

translations.source: Ọ̀ga Olópa wípé àwọn boju ẹlẹ́wọ̀n wá sí ilé ẹjọ́.
translations.reference: Police superintendent Chandra Shekhar Solanki said the accused appeared in court with covered faces.
translations.hypothesis: The police chief stated that the beauty pageant contestants arrived at the hotel.

translations.source: Biotilejepe àwọn èyàn wà nílé náà nígbàtí mọ́́tò kọlù, kò sí kan nínú wọn tó ṣiṣe.
translations.reference: Although three people were inside the house when the car impacted it, none of them were hurt.
translations.hypothesis: Although there were people in the house when the boat sank, none of them were doing anything.

translations.source: Sugbon, awako sese sori gidi.
translations.reference: However, the driver sustained serious injuries to the head.
translations.hypothesis: However, the truth has finally come to light.

translations.source: Wọn ti ọpọpọna ti ijamba naa ti ṣẹlẹ ni titipa fun gba diẹ nigbati awọn oṣiṣẹ pajawiri gbiyanju lati yọ awakọ naa kuro ninu ọkọ Audi TT pupa.
translations.reference: The road where the crash happened was temporarily closed while emergency services freed the driver from the red Audi TT.
translations.hypothesis: Several methods were used to disable the car alarm when thieves attempted to steal a red Audi TT.

translations.source: Ọkùnrin náà kọ́kọ́ wà ní ilé ìwòsàn James Paget ní ìlú ńlá Great Yarmouth.
translations.reference: He was initially hospitalised in the James Paget Hospital in Great Yarmouth.
translations.hypothesis: The man was initially admitted to the James Paget Hospital in the city of Great Yarmouth.

translations.source: Wọ́n padà gbé lọ sí ilé ìwòsàn Addenbrooke tí ó wà ní Cambridge.
translations.reference: He was subsequently relocated to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.
translations.hypothesis: He was subsequently admitted to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.

translations.source: Adékọ̀yà ti wà ní ilé ẹjọ́ Edinburg pẹ́lù ẹ̀sùn pé ó pa ọmọ rẹ̀.
translations.reference: Adekoya has since been in Edinburgh Sheriff Court charged with murdering her son.
translations.hypothesis: A woman appeared in court in Edinburgh, charged with the murder of her child.

translations.source: Ó wà ní àhámọ́ títí dí àkókò ìgbẹ́jọ́ àti ìdájọ́, àmọ́ ó se é se kí wọ́n tọwọ́ bọ ẹ̀rí nítorí pé wọ́n ti gbé àwòrán rẹ̀ kiri jù.
translations.reference: She is in custody pending indictment and trial, but any eyewitness evidence may be tainted because her image has been widely published.
translations.hypothesis: He remained silent throughout the discussion and deliberation, and they eventually accepted his proposal because he had presented a compelling argument.

translations.source: Èyí lọ̀pọ̀ ohun tí wọ́n má ń se ní US àmọ́ ìdàjọ́ ilẹ̀ Scottish siṣẹ́ yàtọ̀ àti wípé ilé ẹjọ́ má ń ka àwọn àwòrán tí wọ́n bá gbé síta bí ohun tó lè fa ẹlẹ́yàmẹ̀yà.
translations.reference: This is common practice elsewhere in the UK but Scottish justice works differently and courts have viewed publication of photos as potentially prejudicial.
translations.hypothesis: This refers to several things that are common in the United States, including the prevalence of Scottish-themed businesses and the fact that courts often consider images that are deemed offensive when making decisions.

translations.source: Omowe Pamela Fegusini tí Ilé Ẹ̀kọ́ Gíga Dondi wipe erékéré ní awon oníròyìn tó n ya àwòrán àwọn tí a fẹ̀sùn kàn, n ṣe.”
translations.reference: Professor Pamela Ferguson of the University of Dundee notes "journalists do seem to be walking a dangerous line if publishing photos etc of suspects."
translations.hypothesis: Pamela Fergusini, a student at the University of Dundee, has been recognized for her work in journalism, specifically for her coverage of issues related to mental health.
