translations.source: Irúfẹ́ olùṣàkóso yìí ni ìṣòro láti gbé àwọn ìgbéṣẹ tí ó yàtò sí ti àtẹ̀yìnwá, bí bà ẹnìyàn wí, ṣíṣe ìgbéléwọ̀n, fífunni ní ojúṣe àti mímú àwọn ẹnìyàn ṣe ohun tí ó tọ́, kí wọ́n sì jábọ̀ rẹ̀.
translations.reference: This type of manager has difficulty making unpopular decisions, performing disciplinary action, performance evaluations, assigning responsibility, and holding people accountable.
translations.hypothesis: This type of leader is characterized by their ability to guide people through difficult times, to inspire them to action, to provide clarity and direction, and to earn their respect and trust.

translations.source: Lẹyin gbogbo làálàá kòókòó, ẹmi a kan dédé wọ inú ẹnikan tí kò tilẹ̀ já mọ́ nǹkankan tí o rò pé òun jẹ́ nǹkan, a sì léro pé òun gbọdọ̀ tún gbogbo nnkan tí ìgbìmọ̀ ti ṣe ṣe, kí ó sì sọ ó di ti ara rẹ̀.
translations.reference: At the other end of the spectrum, one morphs into an unrecognizable individual that feels he or she must change everything the team has been doing and make it their own.
translations.hypothesis: After all the chaos and confusion, I found myself inside someone who didn't know anything, someone who thought they were something, and I realized that they had to relearn everything that society had taught them, and make it their own.

translations.source: Nígbẹ̀yìn gbogbo rẹ̀, aládarí náà ní yíó wà nídìí àseyọrí àti ìjákulẹ̀ ikọ̀ rẹ.
translations.reference: After all, the leader is ultimately responsible for the success and failure of the team.
translations.hypothesis: Ultimately, the leader's success and the growth of their influence depend on their integrity.

translations.source: Irúfẹ́ ìwà yìí máa ń fa ìkùnsínú láàrín olórí àti àwọn ọmọ ìgbìmọ̀ tó k.
translations.reference: This behavior oftentimes results in rifts between the leaders and the rest of the team.
translations.hypothesis: This type of behavior often creates tension between the leader and the members of the team.

translations.source: Àwọn ẹgbẹ́ àfojúrí ní a gbé papọ̀ bí ẹgbẹ́ tí a kan ní ìgbàgba nínú rẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n ìyàtọ̀ díẹ̀ wà nínú rẹ̀.
translations.reference: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences.
translations.hypothesis: The support groups were formed as a collective, but there were some differences among them.

translations.source: Àwọn ọmọ ëgbẹ́ ojú ayélujára ma n sábà dúró gẹ́gẹ́ bí ẹni tí a lè kọ́kọ́ pè sí fún ẹgbẹ́ wọn lojú ayé.
translations.reference: Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group.
translations.hypothesis: Members of the aviation industry often stand as representatives of their organizations in the real world.

translations.source: Ọ̀pọ̀ ìgbà ni wọ́n máa ń ni àwọn ọmọ ìgbìmọ̀ tí o máa ń fa ìdádúró ju èyí tí ó fàyè gba àṣà lọ, torí àsìkò tí àwọn ẹgbẹ́ wọ̀nyí máa ń pàdá máa ń yàtọ̀ sí ara wọn, tí èyí tí ó lè má yé àwọn Aṣojú wọn lábẹ́lé.
translations.reference: They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management.
translations.hypothesis: There have been many instances where academic institutions have caused more harm than good, due to the internal conflicts within these institutions, which can undermine the authority of their leaders.

translations.source: Wíwà “ẹgbẹ́ airi” tooto (Lasini ati LaFeasto, 1989, p109) náa jẹ́ àra àdáyatọ̀ ẹgbẹ́ orí ayélujára.
translations.reference: The presence of a true “invisible team” (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team.
translations.hypothesis: The true meaning of "team spirit" (Lasini and LaFeasto, 1989, p109) is a distinct characteristic of a successful team.

translations.source: Àwọn “ikọ̀ àìrí” ni wọ́n ń se ìsàkóso ikọ̀ èyí táwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ jábọ̀ fún. Ikọ̀ àìrí ti se ágbékalẹ̀ ìlànà fáwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́.
translations.reference: The “invisible team” is the management team to which each of the members report. The invisible team sets the standards for each member.
translations.hypothesis: "Internal conflicts" are the issues that members of the group are struggling with. These internal conflicts have created divisions within the group.

translations.source: Báwo ni àjọ kan yóò ṣe fẹ́ láti lá irúfẹ́ ìpèníjà ìdásílẹ̀ àjọ fún ìkọ́ni kọjá? Ìpinnu kan tí o lè mú kí èyí ṣe é ṣe ni ìmú ohun titun wá.
translations.reference: Why would an organization want to go through the time consuming process of establishing a learning organization? One goal for putting organizational learning concepts into practice is innovation.
translations.hypothesis: How can an organization foster a culture of innovation and encourage employees to come up with new ideas? One possible solution is to create a system that rewards and recognizes innovative thinking.

translations.source: Nígbàtí gbogbo àwọn ohun àmúlò bá jẹ́ lílò káàkiri àwọn ẹ̀ka tó ń ṣiṣẹ́ ní àjọ, ìṣẹ̀dá àti níní ọpọlọ lè wáyé.
translations.reference: When all available resources are effectively used across the functional departments of an organization, creativity and ingenuity can transpire.
translations.hypothesis: When all the necessary resources are readily available across different departments within an organization, innovation and progress can flourish.

translations.source: Nitori na, ilana ti ile ise ma n fi fimosokan lati bori idiwo le tona si ilana ati sin onibaara titun to mogbon wa.
translations.reference: As a result, the process of an organization working together to overcome an obstacle can lead to a new innovative process to serve the customer's need.
translations.hypothesis: Therefore, the company's policies are constantly evolving to adapt to changing circumstances and to better serve our new and existing customers.

translations.source: Kí ni àjọ kan tó lè mú ọgbọ́n wá, àwọn adarí gbọdọ̀ ṣe àgbékalẹ̀ àṣà tí wọ́n yóò fi máa fi ikùlukùn tí wọn yóò si máa jùmọ̀ kọ èkọ́.
translations.reference: Before an organization can be innovative, leadership must create a culture of innovation as well as shared knowledge and organizational learning.
translations.hypothesis: To foster a culture of learning, leaders must establish traditions that encourage curiosity and provide opportunities for continuous education.

translations.source: Angelin (2006) sàlàyé pe ọ̀nà ìṣe Kontinuumi jẹ́ ìgbésẹ̀ tí à n fi bá àwọn ilé ìṣẹ́ dẹ́ ipò ìṣe gíga.
translations.reference: Angel (2006), explains the Continuum approach as a method being used to help organizations reach a higher level of performance.
translations.hypothesis: Angelín (2006) explained that the Continuous Improvement methodology is a process used by companies to achieve high levels of operational performance.

translations.source: Àlàyé nurolọ́gíkà pèsè ẹ̀rí fún ìṣesí ìwékíkọ tí ó tẹ̀le tíọ́rì láti ṣe ìwádí kọgníṣonì. Torínáà ó mú Kí ìwádí náa dá lórí nkan tó kàn gangan.
translations.reference: Neurobiological data provide physical evidence for a theoretical approach to the investigation of cognition. Therefore it narrows the research area and makes it much more exact.

translations.reference: For example, each year students from Bennet School in North Carolina design a website about their trip to the State Capital, each year the website gets remodeled, but old versions are kept online to serve as a scrapbook.

translations.source: Ìtàkùn Blog náà lè se ìrànwọ́ fún ìkọ̀wé àwọn akẹ́ẹ̀kọ́. Nígbàtí àwọn akẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìrírí ìtàkùn blog ti wọn pẹ̀lú ìlo èdè àti àkọtọ́ tó wọ́, wíwà nílẹ̀ àwọn èrò ma ń yí èyí padà.
translations.reference: Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that.
translations.hypothesis: A blog can be a valuable resource for students. When students start researching a blog topic using relevant keywords, they can quickly find a wealth of information.

translations.source: Nigba ti o ti je pe awon akeeko mma n tako ju, onkowe blogi ma n sa gbogbo agbara lati dara si ki o baa le yera fun itako.

translations.hypothesis: When the competition for beauty products is fierce, bloggers often go to great lengths to stand out and promote their favorite products.

translations.source: Blogging, “ti kàn án nípá fáwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ láti fẹ ní ìmọ̀ àti òye kíkún nípa ayé tó yí wọn ká” èròǹgbà àti ìlò láti wo ṣàkun ohun tí àwọn olùgbọ́ ń fẹ́ kí wọn sì ṣe e fún wọn ni ó mú kí àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ gbọ́n nínú gbọ́n ní ìlta, tí wọ́n si ń ṣe ohun tó móríyá. (Toto, 2004)
translations.reference: Also blogging "forces students to become more savvy about the world around them." The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004).
translations.hypothesis: Blogging, "which allows students to share knowledge and understanding about the world around them," is a valuable tool for exploring what students want to learn and for helping them engage with learning in a meaningful way. (Toto, 2004)

translations.source: Búlọ́gìn jẹ́ ohun èlò tó ń ṣe ìwúrí fún àjọṣepọ̀, tí ó sì ń ṣe ìrànwọ́ fún àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ láti mú ìmọ̀ ẹ̀kọ́ kọjá ilé ẹ̀kọ́.
translations.reference: Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day.
translations.hypothesis: Blogs are a valuable tool for communication, and they offer a platform for educators to extend learning beyond the classroom.

translations.source: Lílo ìtàkùn Blog ní ọ̀nà tí ó tọ́ “lè ró àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ní agbára láti di ẹni tó ń wo nǹkan ní àwòfín, tí yóò si lè ṣe ọ̀rínkíniwin rẹ̀; látàrí fífèsì tí ó tọ̀nà sí àwọn nǹkan tí ẹnìyàn ń rí lórí ayélujara, akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ lè sọ nípa ohun tí wọn rò ní pa elọmìíran tàbí sọ èròwọn nípa nǹkan kí nǹkan (Oravec, 2002).
translations.reference: Appropriate use of blogs "can empower students to become more analytical and critical; through actively responding to Internet materials, students can define their positions in the context of others' writings as well as outline their own perspectives on particular issues (Oravec, 2002).
translations.hypothesis: Using a blog as a platform empowers students to become active participants, allowing them to express their thoughts and engage with the material; by sharing their perspectives on various topics, students can contribute to a broader understanding and offer unique insights (Oravec, 2002).

translations.hypothesis: The residents of Lisbon, Portugal, rebuilt their city and gave it a new name, Casa Brance, and they also rebuilt it after the devastating earthquake of 1755.

translations.hypothesis: In the historic city of Medina, it's easy to find shops selling local products, such as tagines, spices, hookah pipes, various types of fabrics, and souvenirs, all catering to tourists.

translations.source: Goma jẹ́ ìlú ìrìn ajo nínú Olominira Kongo ní etí apá ìlà orùn lẹ́gbẹ́ Ruwanda.

translations.hypothesis: Goma is a city located in the Democratic Republic of Congo, in the eastern part of the country, near the border with Rwanda.

translations.source: Ni 2002 Goma parun nitori lafa folkeno Nyiragongo tó ri púpọ̀ nínu títí ìlú pàpà jùlọ ilé ìjọ-ìlú.
translations.reference: In 2002 Goma was destroyed by lava from the Nyiragongo volcano which buried most of the town’s streets, particularly the town centre.
translations.hypothesis: In 2002, Goma was severely affected by the eruption of the Nyiragongo volcano, which caused significant damage, particularly to the city's most vulnerable neighborhoods.

translations.source: Nígbàtí Goma wà ní àbò, èyíkèyí àbẹ̀wò ní ìta Goma ní láti ní ìwádìí kíkún láti ní òye ìjà lemọ́lemọ́ ní agbègbè North Kivu.
translations.reference: While Goma is reasonably safe, any visits outside of Goma should be researched to understand the state of the fighting that persists in the North Kivu province.
translations.hypothesis: When Goma was under attack, the residents outside of Goma were reportedly experiencing widespread fear due to the ongoing conflict in the North Kivu region.

translations.source: Ìlú náà ló tún jẹ́ ibùdó fún gígun ilẹ̀ ríru Nyiragongo pẹ̀lú ìtọpa Oríòkè Gorilla tó dínwó jùlọ nílẹ̀ Adúláwọ̀.
translations.reference: The city is also the base to climb the Nyiragongo volcano along with some of the cheapest Mountain Gorilla tracking in Africa.
translations.hypothesis: The city also serves as a gateway to the Virunga National Park, home to the endangered mountain gorillas.

translations.source: O lè lo boda boda (tákisí ọks alùpùpù) láti rìn kiri Goma. Iye rẹ̀ gangan ni 500 Congolese France fún ìrìn àjò kékeré náà.

translations.hypothesis: You can use a "boda-boda" (a type of motorcycle taxi) to travel to Goma. The fare for a short trip is usually 500 Congolese Francs.

translations.source: Pelu pe o soro die lati de be, “Timbuktu” ti di apere ile alailegbe, jinjin.
translations.reference: Combined with its relative inaccessibility, "Timbuktu" has come to be used as a metaphor for exotic, distant lands.
translations.hypothesis: Despite its length, "Timbuktu" has become a truly iconic film.

translations.source: Lónìí ìlú òtòṣì ní Timbuktu, ṣùgbọ́n ó lorúkọ gẹ́gẹ́ bí ibi tó ma n fẹjúmọ́ àwọn onirinajo, ó sì ní pápá ọkọ̀ òfurufú.
translations.reference: Today, Timbuktu is an impoverished town, although its reputation makes it a tourist attraction, and it has an airport.
translations.hypothesis: Today, Timbuktu is a small city, but it has a rich history as a center of trade and learning, and it was once a major port.

translations.source: Wọ́n sàfikún rẹ̀ sára àwọn àkọọ́lẹ̀ ibùdó ohun ìní àgbáyé tó wà nínú ewu lọ́dún 1990 látàrí ìdúnkokò àwọn yẹ̀pẹ̀ asálẹ̀.
translations.reference: In 1990, it was added to the list of world heritage sites in danger, due to the threat of desert sands.
translations.hypothesis: They were added to the list of endangered species by the International Union for Conservation of Nature in the 1990s due to declining populations.

translations.source: Ó jẹ́ ọ̀kan pàtàkì nínú àwọn ibi tí Henry Louis Gates’ PBS ti dúro nígbà tí ó ń wo àrà tí ó wà ní ilẹ̀ adúláwọ̀.
translations.reference: It was one of the major stops during Henry Louis Gates' PBS special Wonders of the African World.
translations.hypothesis: It was one of the most striking things Henry Louis Gates encountered during his PBS series while exploring his family's history.

translations.source: Ìlú náà yàtọ̀ gédégbé sí àwọn ìlú orílẹ̀èdè yòókù, nítoríwípé ó fara pẹ́ Áràbù ju àwọn adúláwọ̀ lọ.
translations.reference: The city is in stark contrast to the rest of the country's cities, because it has more of an Arabic flair than of an African.
translations.hypothesis: That city is significantly different from other countries because it is more influenced by Arab culture than by its own traditions.

translations.source: Ibi ìgbafẹ́ tí a mọ̀ sí The Kruger National Park (KNP), wà ni àríwá-ìlà oòrùn ti orílẹ̀ èdè South Africa, tí ó sì lọ títí dé ààla Mozambique ní ìlà oòrun Zimbabwe ni àríwá, àti ni a gúsù ni odò Ọ̀nì wà.
translations.reference: The Kruger National Park (KNP) lies in the north-east of South Africa and runs along the border of Mozambique in the east, Zimbabwe in the north, and the southern border is the Crocodile River.
translations.hypothesis: The renowned Kruger National Park (KNP) is located in the northeastern part of South Africa, extending from the border with Mozambique in the east to the border with Zimbabwe in the north, and is bordered to the west by the Olifants River.

translations.source: Àgbègbè ná a bo kìlómítà ẹgbẹ̀rún maọ́kàndínlógún ó lé ẹ̀dẹ́ẹ́gbẹ̀ta ó sì pín sí ̣ dọ́sìnì mẹ́rìnlá ọ̀tọ̀tọ̀, tí ìkọ̀kan ń sagbẹ́tẹrù oríṣìí erankó igbó.
translations.reference: The park covers 19,500 km² and is divided in 14 different ecozones, each supporting different wildlife.
translations.hypothesis: The area covers approximately 3,000 square kilometers and is divided into four distinct regions, each characterized by different types of forest.

translations.source: Ó jẹ ìkan lára [wọn ǹkan tó ma ń fa èrò wá sí South Africa ó sì jẹ́ àmì South African National Parks (SANParks).
translations.reference: It is one of the main attractions of South Africa and it is considered the flagship of South African National Parks (SANParks).
translations.hypothesis: It is one of the things that attracts visitors to South Africa, and it is a symbol of South African National Parks (SANParks).

translations.source: Bí gbogbo Ibi ìgbafẹ́ South Africa, owó ìlẹlé jẹ́̀fẹ́ àwọn oríṣiríṣi ǹkan ló sì wà níbẹ̀.
translations.reference: As with all South African National Parks, there are daily conservation and entry fees for the park.
translations.hypothesis: Like all areas of South Africa, property prices are high, and there is a lot of development happening there.

translations.source: Ó tún le se àǹfànní fún ènìyàn láti ra Wild Card, èyí tí yíó pèsè ìwọlé sí bóyá àwọn ibùdó ní ilẹ̀ South Africa tàbí àwọn ibùdó àpapọ̀ tàwọn ènìyàn South Africa.
translations.reference: It may also be beneficial for one to buy a Wild Card, which provides entry to either selections of parks in South Africa or all of the South African National Parks.
translations.hypothesis: It can also be beneficial for people to purchase a Wild Card, which provides access to various attractions, either within South Africa or to attractions popular with South African tourists.

translations.source: Irekusu Hon Kongi fun agbegbe Hon Kongi ni oruko re o de je ibi ti abewo pupo ma n dojuko ju.
translations.reference: Hong Kong Island gives the territory of Hong Kong its name and is the place that many tourists regard as the main focus.
translations.hypothesis: The Irekusu Hon Kongi area, named after the Hon Kongi region, is a place that attracts a large number of visitors.

translations.source: Àwọn àfihàn àwọn ilé tó mún kí ojú òpó Hong Kong rẹwà ni ati fi wé àtẹ tí ó ń dán èyí tó tàn nípa omi Victoria Harbour tó wà nílẹ̀.
translations.reference: The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour.
translations.hypothesis: The stunning views from the luxury apartments in Hong Kong, which offer a breathtaking panorama, are now partially obscured by a new structure built over Victoria Harbour.

translations.source: Láti lè rí Hong Kong dáadáa, fi island sílẹ̀ kí o sì lọ sí ibi omi Kowlon.
translations.reference: To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite.
translations.hypothesis: To truly experience Hong Kong, take a ferry across the harbor to Kowloon.

translations.source: Ọ̀pọ̀ nínú ìdàgbàsókè tí ó wáyé ní ìgboro erékùsù Hong Kong ni ó wọ́pọ̀ láwọn ilẹ̀ tí ó wà ní àríwá etí òku.
translations.reference: The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore.
translations.hypothesis: Many of the protests that erupted in the special administrative region of Hong Kong were organized by people from mainland China.

translations.source: Ibi tí àwọn amúnisin mú gẹ́gẹ́ bi tiwọn ni èyí, fún ìdí èyí, tí o bá ń wa ẹ̀rí nípa ìmúnisìn ní àtijọ́, ibi yìí ni ó dára láti bẹ̀rẹ̀.
translations.reference: This is the place the British colonisers took as their own and so if you are looking for evidence of the territory's colonial past, this is a good place to start.
translations.hypothesis: This is a great resource for anyone interested in history, and it's a good place to start if you're new to the subject.

translations.source: Sundarbans jẹ́ agbègbè tí igi tí ń wù láàrìn omi tó tóbi jùlọ ní àgbáyé,tó sì gùn dé 80 km (50 mi) sínu Bangladeshi àti ibi tí kò sí omi ní Indian .
translations.reference: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast.
translations.hypothesis: The Sundarbans is a region with the largest mangrove forests in the world, extending approximately 80 kilometers (50 miles) into Bangladesh and the Indian mainland.

translations.source: Wọ́n ti kéde Sundarbans gẹ́gẹ́ bí ti UNESCO World Heritage Site. Èyí tó jẹ́ara igbó tówà lẹ́kùn India ní wọn ń pè ní ibùdó àpapọ̀ Sundarbans.
translations.reference: The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park.
translations.hypothesis: The Sundarbans is recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It is a vast mangrove forest located in the delta region of India, known as the Sundarbans.

translations.source: Awon igbokiji kii se eera mangurufi nikan sa- lara re ni die ninu awon ite igbokiji nla to ku ti o figba kan bo gbogbo ile Gangetiki.
translations.reference: The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain.
translations.hypothesis: The inscriptions are not just meaningless symbols; they are actually part of a larger system of writing that once covered the entire Gangetic plain.

translations.source: Ẹranko tí a mọ̀ sí Sundarbans gba agbègbè kan tí ó ó tó 3,850 km², ní èyí bí ìdámẹ́ta agbègbè náà jẹ́ kìkìdá omi/ir.
translations.reference: The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas.
translations.hypothesis: The tiger, known to inhabit the Sundarbans, occupies an area of approximately 3,850 square kilometers, with about two-thirds of this area being water.

translations.source: Lati 1966, awon Sundabani ti je ile mimo eranko, won daba pe bii ekun Bengali Oloba 400 ati agbonrin alami 30,00 nlo wa ni agbegbe naa.
translations.reference: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
translations.hypothesis: Since 1966, the Sundarbans has been a protected wildlife reserve, and it is home to approximately 400 Bengal tigers and 30,000 spotted deer.

translations.source: Àwọn ọkọ̀ akérò kúrò ní ìbúdò wọ́n (ní ìkọjá odò) láti àárọ̀ títí di alẹ́,ṣùgbọ́n púpọ̀, pàápàá àwọn tó ń lọ sí ilà oòrùn àti Jakar/Bumthang ma ń kúrò láàrín ago mẹ́fà àbọ̀ àti ago méje àbọ̀.
translations.reference: Buses depart the inter-district bus station (across the river) throughout the day, though most, especially those heading to the east and Jakar/Bumthang leave between 06:30 and 07:30.
translations.hypothesis: Ferries operated across the river (connecting different areas) from morning until night, providing a vital service, especially for those traveling to the eastern regions and Jakar/Bumthang, with departures occurring approximately every six to seven hours.

translations.source: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí àwọn ọkọ̀ akérò làti ẹkùn kan sí òmíràn se ma ń kún lọ́pọ́ ìgbà, ó dárá láti ra tíkẹ̀ẹ̀tì ní ọjọ́ díẹ̀ sílẹ̀.
translations.reference: As the inter-district buses are often full, it is advisable to purchase a ticket a few days in advance.
translations.hypothesis: Just like buses often get stuck in traffic, this one was delayed for a while, having arrived late the previous day.

translations.source: Ọ̀pọ̀ agbè̀gbè ń jẹ àǹfàní ọkọ̀ akérò kékeré ilẹ̀ Japan, àwọn èyí tí o ní ìtura àti ìdúrósinsin.
translations.reference: Most districts are served by small Japanese Coaster Buses, which are comfortable and sturdy.
translations.hypothesis: Many regions are known for their unique and charming miniature trains in Japan.

translations.source: Takisi àjọgbàpọ̀ jẹ́ ọ̀nà tí ó yá tí ó sì rọrùn jùlọ láti rín ìrìn lọ sí àwọn ibi tí kò jìnnà, bíi Paro tí kò jú (Nu àádọ́jọ) lọ àt Punakha ní (Nu igba).
translations.reference: Shared taxis are a quick and comfortable means to travel to nearby places, such as Paro (Nu 150) and Punakha (Nu 200).
translations.hypothesis: Shared taxis are a convenient and affordable way to travel to remote locations, such as from Paro Airport (Bhutan) to Punakha (Bhutan).

translations.source: Afara ori Odo Oyapock je afara odo ti a fi okun gbero. o la odo Oyapock ja o si je isopo awon ilu bi Oiapoque ni Brazil and Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock ni French Guiana.
translations.reference: The Oyapock River Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge. It spans the Oyapock River to link the cities of Oiapoque in Brazil and Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock in French Guiana.
translations.hypothesis: The Oyapock River is a river that forms a natural border. It is the boundary between the cities of Oiapoque in Brazil and Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock in French Guiana.

translations.source: Awon ile nla mejeji ga to 83 meters, o gun to 378 meters o de ni oju ona meji to fe to 3.50m.
translations.reference: The two towers rise to a height of 83 meters, it's 378 meters long and it has two lanes of 3.50 m wide.
translations.hypothesis: The two large buildings are 83 meters tall, extend for 378 meters in length, and have a width of approximately 3.50 meters.

translations.source: Gíga ìbú abẹ́ afárá jẹ́ bí i mítà márùndínlógún. Kíkọ́ rẹ̀ parí nínú oṣù kẹjọ ọdún 2011, kò sísílẹ̀ fún ìrìnlọrìnbọ̀ títí di oṣù kẹta ọdún 2017.
translations.reference: The vertical clearance under the bridge is 15 meters. Construction was completed in August 2011, it didn't open to traffic until March 2017.
translations.hypothesis: The Gigantic African Baobab tree is approximately 1,600 years old. Its growth began in September 2011, and it continued to expand until March 2017.

translations.source: Afára náà ni wọ́n ní yíò bẹ̀rẹ̀ iṣẹ́ nínú osù kẹsàn án ọdún 2017, nígbà ìrètí wà wípé kí ilé-iṣẹ́ asọbodè ilẹ̀ Brazil parí àwọn ẹnubode.
translations.reference: The bridge is scheduled to be fully operational in September 2017, when the Brazilian customs checkpoints are expected to be finished.
translations.hypothesis: The company began operations in September 2017, with the expectation that the Brazilian textile industry would require more skilled workers.

translations.source: Àwọn ènìyàn Guarani ni wọ́n jẹ́ ènìyàn ìbílẹ̀ tó ń gbé ibi tó jẹ́ ìlà oòrùn Paraguay báyìí, wọ́n ń gbé bí i apwọn ọdẹ tí ó tún siṣẹ́ ohun ọ̀gbìn alárojẹ.
translations.reference: The Guaraní were the most significant indigenous group inhabiting what is now Eastern Paraguay, living as semi-nomadic hunters who also practised subsistence agriculture.
translations.hypothesis: The Guarani people are an indigenous group who currently live in the eastern region of Paraguay, and they maintain a traditional way of life that also incorporates modern technology.

translations.source: Ẹkun ti Chaco jẹ ile fun ọpọlọpọ ẹgbẹ awọn ẹya abinibi bi Guaycurú ati Payaguá, ti o jẹ iṣẹ ọdẹ ṣiṣe ati ẹja pipa ni won yan laayo.
translations.reference: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering and fishing.
translations.hypothesis: The Chaco region is home to numerous indigenous groups, such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who traditionally engaged in hunting, gathering, and fishing.

translations.source: Ní sẹ́ntúrì kẹrìndínlógún, Paraguay tí wọ́n pè ní “Agbègbè Nlá tí Indíaì” ni wọ́n bií látàrí láti ìpàdé àwọn aṣẹ́gun ilẹ̀ Spain pẹ̀lú àwọn ęgbẹ́ ìbílẹ̀.
translations.reference: In the 16th century Paraguay, formerly called "The Giant Province of the Indies", was born as a result of the encounter of Spanish conquerors with the native indigenous groups.
translations.hypothesis: In the 16th century, the territory that would become Paraguay was formed as a result of encounters between Spanish conquistadors and indigenous groups.

translations.source: Àwọn ará Spain bẹ̀rẹ̀ àkòkò ìsèjọba amúnisìn èyí tó pẹ́ tó sẹ́ńtúrì mẹ́ta.
translations.reference: The Spaniards started the colonization period which lasted for three centuries.
translations.hypothesis: The Spanish people began this period of political instability in the early 21st century.

translations.source: Láti ipile Asensioni ní 1537, Paragueti gbìyànjú láti pa púpọ̀ nínú ìwà àti ìyàtọ̀ rẹ̀ mọ́.
translations.reference: Since the foundation of Asunción in 1537, Paraguay has managed to keep a lot of its indigenous character and identity.
translations.hypothesis: Since its founding in 1537, Paraguay has been a country known for its unique culture and traditions.

translations.source: A mọ ìlú Argentina nitorí wọ́n ní ẹgbẹ́ polo àti òṣèrè ní àgbáyé.
translations.reference: Argentina is well known for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.
translations.hypothesis: I know Argentina because they have a strong polo team and are known for their passion for the sport.

translations.source: Eré ìje tó tóbi jù lọ́dún ma wáyé nínú oṣù kejì ní pápá ìṣeré polo ní Las Can̂itas.
translations.reference: The largest tournament of the year takes place in December at the polo fields in Las Cañitas.
translations.hypothesis: The largest polo tournament of the year will take place in the second week of the month at the polo club in Las Cañitas.

translations.source: Idije kekeeke ati opolopo ifigagagba ni o tun le je wiwo ni awon akoko ninu odun miran.
translations.reference: Smaller tournaments and matches can also be seen here at other times of the year.
translations.hypothesis: Small-scale conflicts and various disagreements can also occur at different times throughout the year.

translations.source: Fún ìròyìn lórí eré ìje àti bi à ti ra ìwé ìwọlé fún ìdíje polo, lọ wo ẹgbẹ́ Argentina de Polo.
translations.reference: For news on tournaments and where to buy tickets for polo matches, check Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
translations.hypothesis: For news about polo matches and information on how to purchase tickets for the polo competition, please visit the Argentina de Polo website.

translations.source: Owó Falklands ni pọ́ùn Falklandtí (FKP) èyí tí iye rẹ̀ jẹ́ ìkan pẹ̀lú iye pọ́ùn ilẹ̀ Britain (GBP).
translations.reference: The official Falklands currency is the Falkland pound (FKP) whose value is set equivalent to that of one British pound (GBP).
translations.hypothesis: The currency of the Falkland Islands is the Falkland Pound (FKP), which has the same value as the British Pound (GBP).

translations.source: Ilé ìfowópamọ́sí tó wà ní erékùsù ní Stanley káàkiri ibi ìtajà ìwọ̀ oòrùn FIC nìkan ni o ti lè pààrọ̀ owó.
translations.reference: Money can be exchanged at the only bank in the islands which is located in Stanley across from the FIC West store.
translations.hypothesis: The only ATM located in the Stanley area, specifically near the eastern entrance of the FIC shopping complex, was the one that was dispensing cash.

translations.source: Ní gbogbo apa irekusu naa, wọ́n ma n gba Pọ́n ìlú Ọba pẹ̀lú ní ibi tí káàdì àwìn àti Dola Ìlú Amerika.
translations.reference: British pounds will generally be accepted anywhere in the islands and within Stanley credit cards and United States dollars are also often accepted.
translations.hypothesis: Throughout the entire process, the city of Porto was closely linked to both the European Union and the United States of America.

translations.source: Wọn lẹ má gba káàdì àwìn ní àwọn ìrékùsù tó wa ní pípépe, àmọ wọn lẹ gba àwọn owó ìlú Ọba àti ìlú Amèrìká, kọ́kọ́ sẹ àyèwo pèlú àwọn to ni ibè làti mọ nkan tí wọn lẹ gba gẹ́gẹ́ bii ìlànà ìsanwó.
translations.reference: On the outlying islands credit cards will probably not be accepted, although British and United States currency may be taken; check with the owners in advance to determine what is an acceptable payment method.
translations.hypothesis: They often accept credit cards at larger establishments, and their customers include both local residents and tourists, who are often interested in learning about local customs, including payment methods.

translations.source: O fee je nkan ti o seese lati paro owo Falklandi nita awon irekusu naa, tori naa paro owo ki o to kuro ni awon irekusu naa.
translations.reference: It is nearly impossible to exchange Falklands currency outside of the islands, so exchange money prior to leaving the islands.
translations.hypothesis: It is important to stop the Falkland Islands from being exploited for its resources, and to ensure that the benefits of those resources are shared with the local population.

translations.source: Níbi ìlú Montevideo se jẹ́ ẹkùn gúúsù ìlà agbede ayé, ó má ń tutù láàkókò ìgbà òtútù ní ẹkùn àríwá àarin róbótó àti ìdàkejì.
translations.reference: Since Montevideo is south of the Equator, it is summer there when it's winter in the Northern Hemisphere and vice versa.
translations.hypothesis: In the city of Montevideo, Uruguay, the average temperature during the summer months (December to February) ranges from mild to warm.

translations.source: Montevideo wà ní ilé olóoru; ní àwọn oṣù àkókò eèrùn, ìwọ̀n ooru tó má ń wọ́pọ̀ ni èyí tó ma ń ju +30°C lọ.
translations.reference: Montevideo is in the subtropics; in the summer months, temperatures above +30°C are common.
translations.hypothesis: Montevideo experiences a humid climate; during the summer months, the average temperature often exceeds +30°C.

translations.source: Ìgbà òtútù le fẹ́ tutù alárúmọjẹ, àwọn ìwọ̀n òtútù ki sábà kẹ́rẹ́ sí dídì sùgbọ́n afẹ́fẹ́ áti ọ̀rìn nínú òtútù màa ǹ papọ̀ láti mú dàbí pẹ́ ó tutù ju bí èrọ ìgbóná tí se wọ̀n lọ.
translations.reference: The winter can be deceptively chilly: temperatures rarely go below freezing, but the wind and humidity combine to make it feel colder than what the thermometer says.
translations.hypothesis: The hot season can bring intense heat, and while air conditioners offer relief, fans and curtains work together to create a cooler environment, often making the difference more noticeable than a single air conditioner alone.

translations.source: Kò sí àsìkò “òjò” àti “ẹ̀rùn” ní pàtó: òjò̀ a máa wáyé yípo ọdún ní ìgbàmìíràn.
translations.reference: There are no particular "rainy" and "dry" seasons: the amount of rain stays roughly the same throughout the year.
translations.hypothesis: There is no clear distinction between the words "ojò" and "ẹ̀rùn": "ojò" can sometimes refer to a period of time, especially a long one.

translations.source: Lóòtọ́, ó ti mọ́ ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn ẹranko tó wà nínú ààyè lára láti má a rí àwọn èèyàn, àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí inú igbó jẹ́ tigbó, tí kò si yẹ kí wọ́n má a fún wọn ní oúnjẹ́ tàbí dàwọn láàmùn.
translations.reference: Though many of the animals in the park are used to seeing humans, the wildlife is nonetheless wild and should not be fed or disturbed.
translations.hypothesis: Indeed, many animals in the wild have been observed by humans, including forest creatures like tigers, and it is not appropriate to feed them or give them human food.

translations.source: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí àwọn aláṣẹ ibùdó ṣe sọ, jẹ́ kí ó kéré tán ọgọ́rùn ún ọ̀pa ìwọ̀n wà láàárín àgbọ̀nrin àti ìkokò àti ìwọ̀n ọ̀pá márùndínlógún sí àwọn ẹranko ìgbẹ́ tí ó kù!
translations.reference: According to park authorities, stay at least 100 yards/meters away from bears and wolves and 25 yards/meters from all other wild animals!
translations.hypothesis: According to reports from the authorities, at least nine people were injured in a collision between a motorcycle and a car, and sixteen more were injured in a separate accident involving a truck and several other vehicles.

translations.source: Ko si bi oju won se le rele to, bisoni, elki, moosi, esi ati gbogbo eranko nla le doju ko en.
translations.reference: No matter how docile they may look, bison, elk, moose, bears, and nearly all large animals can attack.
translations.hypothesis: No matter how tired their eyes may be, whether from business, reading, watching television, using a computer, or any other demanding activity, they can still see clearly.

translations.source: Ní ọdọdún, àwọn àlejo tó tó méjìlá ló ṣèṣe nítorí wọn kò fi àyè sílẹ̀ dáadáa. Àwọn eranko wọ́nyí tóbí, wọ́n sí le gan, wan sí léwu, nítorínà fún wọ́n ní àyè wọn.
translations.reference: Each year, dozens of visitors are injured because they didn't keep a proper distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so give them their space.
translations.hypothesis: In the past, two people were injured because they didn't properly use their brakes. These incidents, and others like them, highlight the importance of having functioning brakes. That's why it's crucial to maintain them.

translations.reference: Cancellation policies vary, but as of late March most coronavirus-based cancellation policies don't extend to July 2020, when the Olympics had been scheduled.
translations.hypothesis: Our initial plans were solid, but by the end of 2020, many of the travel restrictions imposed due to the Coronavirus pandemic remained in place, which made it difficult to proceed with the Olympics.

translations.source: A ti mọ̀ pé púpọ̀ nínú àwọn tíkẹ́tì fún party ma ń jẹ́ ¥2,500 àti ¥130,000, pẹ̀lú irú tíkẹ́tì kanáà tó jẹ́ ¥7,000.
translations.reference: It's expected that most event tickets will cost between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, with typical tickets costing around ¥7,000.
translations.hypothesis: I understand that many of the tickets for the party range from ¥2,500 to ¥130,000, with some special tickets costing ¥7,000.

translations.source: Lìlọ àwọn asọ tútù máà n jẹ kí wọn gbẹ. Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ ilé ìtura ní ohun èlò láti lọ asọ fún ẹ̀yáwó, bó tilè jépé ènìyàn o sí nínú yàrá ilé ìtura.
translations.reference: Ironing damp clothes can help them dry. Many hotels have an iron and ironing board available for loan, even if one is not present in the room.
translations.hypothesis: Beautiful clothes often make people happy. Many tailoring businesses offer services to create wedding outfits, and this is a thriving industry.

translations.source: Bí kò bá sí ẹ̀rọ ìlọsọ àbí tí o bá nífẹ̀ẹ́ sí à ti wọ ìbọ̀sẹ̀ tó bágbà mun èyí ti a ti lọ̀, nígbànáà ní o lè lo ẹ̀eọ ìgbẹrun tó bá wà nílẹ̀.
translations.reference: If an iron isn't available, or if you don't fancy wearing ironed socks, then you can try using a hairdryer, if available.
translations.hypothesis: If you don't have a computer or if you prefer a more traditional method, you can use a readily available tool: a calculator.

translations.source: Sọ́ra kí o ma se jẹ́kí aṣọ náà gbóná jù, (èyi tó lè fa ìsúnkì tàbí kó jó tó bá ti pọ̀jù).
translations.reference: Be careful not to allow fabric to become too hot (which can cause shrinkage, or in extreme cases, scorch).
translations.hypothesis: Make sure the fabric is not too tight (as this could cause discomfort or restrict movement).

translations.source: Orísìí ọ̀nà lówà láti ya omi sí mímọ́, àwọn ọ̀kan lè gbógun ti àwọn ìdúnkokò kọ̀ọ̀kan.
translations.reference: There are different ways of purifying water, some more effective against specific threats.
translations.hypothesis: There are various ways to purify water, and each method has its own advantages.

translations.source: Láwọn apá kan, bí wọ́n bá ti gbé omi kaná fún ìṣẹ́jú kan, ó ti tó, à mọ́ láwọn apá míràn wọ́n nílò ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ìṣẹ́jú.
translations.reference: In some areas boiling water for a minute is enough, in others several minutes are needed.
translations.hypothesis: In some cases, a single minute is enough to complete a task, while in other cases, it requires a much longer time.

translations.source: Àwọn amóhundára pé orísìírísìí, bí o bá sìní ẹ̀dùn, o lè se àgbéwò à ti ra omi nínú ìgò tí wọ́n ti lẹ̀ láti iléeṣẹ́ tó níyì.
translations.reference: Filters vary in effectiveness, and should you have a concern, then you should consider buying your water in a sealed bottle from a reputable company.
translations.hypothesis: Different flavors, and if you enjoy them, you can try adding water to the ice cream that you bought from the store.

translations.source: Àwọn arìnrìnàjò lè salábàápàdé àwọn ẹranko ayọnilẹ́nu tí wọn kò dámọ̀ ní agbègbè ilé wọn.
translations.reference: Travellers may encounter animal pests that they are not familiar with in their home regions.
translations.hypothesis: Travelers may encounter dangerous animals that they are not familiar with in a new area.

translations.source: Àwọn kòkòrò lè ba oúnjẹ jẹ́, fa ìríra tàbí tó bá le tán fa ẹ̀hún ara, tí oró rẹ̀ yíó ma káàkiri tàbí ran ẹlòmíràn.
translations.reference: Pests can spoil food, cause irritation, or in a worse case cause allergic reactions, spread venom, or transmit infections.
translations.hypothesis: Cars can consume food, generate heat, or, in extreme cases, even cause physical harm, and their impact can be widespread or affect individuals directly.

translations.source: Ààrùn tó ń ràn gan tàbí àwọn ẹranko burúkú tó lè sèpalára tàbí sekúpa ènìyàn tipatipá kì í sábàá jẹ́ kòkòrò ayọnilẹ́nu.
translations.reference: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
translations.hypothesis: Serious illnesses or harmful substances that can cause severe harm or death should never be taken lightly.

translations.source: ìraja Duty free ni àǹfàní láti ra àwọn ọjà tí wọ́n ti yọ owó orí kúrò tí ó sì wà láwọn agbègbè kan.
translations.reference: Duty free shopping is the opportunity to buy goods exempted from taxes and excises at certain locations.
translations.hypothesis: Duty-free shops are places where you can buy goods without paying taxes, and they are often located in specific areas.

translations.source: Àwọn tó ń lọ sí àwọn orílẹ̀ tí wọ́n tí ń sanwó orí gegere nígbà míràn lè fí owó tó pọ̀ pamọ̀, pàápàá lórí ìpèsè bí i ọtí, ẹlẹ́rìndòdò àti tábà.
translations.reference: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.
translations.hypothesis: Those who travel to countries that previously had strict regulations on personal items like alcohol, tobacco, and toiletries may now be able to bring more with them, depending on the specific rules.

translations.source: Ààyè tí ó wà láàrin Point Marion àti Fairmont se àfihàn àwọn ìpènijà àwọn awakọ̀ ní ojú ọ̀nà márosẹ̀ Buffalo-Pittsburgh, ní gbogbo igbà tí wọ́n bá gba àwọn ojú òpó tó dáwà kọjá.
translations.reference: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
translations.hypothesis: The section of the Buffalo-Pittsburgh highway between Point Marion and Fairmont is known for its steep inclines, which can be challenging for truck drivers, especially when they are carrying heavy loads.

translations.source: Tí wíwa ọks kò bá ma ẹ lára ní òpópónà , má sọ̀rọ̀ nípa ǹkan tí o lè ṣe. àwọn ọ̀nà tó lọ sókè tó tun lọ sílẹ̀, àwọn ọ̀nà tóró, àti ọ̀nà tó tẹ̀ borí.
translations.reference: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
translations.hypothesis: If you find yourself stuck in traffic, try to focus on something positive. Think about the routes you've taken before that were successful, the routes that are currently open, and the routes that might be passable.

translations.source: Òsùwọ̀n eré sísá tí a má ń kà sáàba má n kéré ju tàwọn agbọn àtẹ̀yìnwá lọ- lọ́pọ̀ ìgbà ó ma ń jẹ́ láàrin máìlì márùndínlógójì sí ogóji wákàtí kan (56mẹ́rìndínlọ́gọta-mẹ́rìnlélọ́gọ́ta kìlómítà wákàtí) - ati pe igboran pípe sí i se pàtàkì ju àìgbọ́ràn lọ.
translations.reference: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
translations.hypothesis: The duration of a standard marathon race is often longer than the time it takes to complete ultramarathons, typically ranging from one hour and forty-two minutes to six hours (approximately 56.4 to 216 minutes, or 1.4 to 3.6 miles per hour). However, the importance of pacing is arguably even greater in ultramarathons.

translations.source: Ìyàlẹ́nu ló jẹ́ ná pé iṣẹ́ ẹrọ alágbèéká ṣiṣẹ́ dáadáa ní ibíyìí ju ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn agbègbẹ̀ mìíràn lọ, bíi Aginjù Pennsylvania.
translations.reference: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
translations.hypothesis: It is reported that the electric grid in this region is functioning better than in many other areas, including Pennsylvania.

translations.source: Àwọn páfuj Jamani dáa àti ní Baferia, wọ́n ki wọ́n dẹ̀ pe oríṣi , bíi tí Ostria tó wà lẹ́gbẹ́ wọn ní apá guusu.
translations.reference: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
translations.hypothesis: The German and Belgian borders, like the Austrian border to the south, are well-defined.

translations.source: Èso apple ni wọ́n má ń fi se àfúnpọ̀ èso júlọ yípo ọdún, nígbà tí wọ́n má ń lo èso ṣẹrí àti púlọ̀mù lákòókò ooru.
translations.reference: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
translations.hypothesis: Apples are the most popular fruit consumed annually, while citrus fruits and plums are commonly eaten during the summer months.

translations.source: Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ọjà German ni almonds, lpà, àti àwọn ẹ̀pa orí igi wà nínú rẹ̀. Àwọn àkàrà òyìnbó tí a mọ̀ dáadáa ní a lè jẹ́ pẹ̀lú ife coffee.
translations.reference: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
translations.hypothesis: Many German products contain almonds, nuts, and tree seeds. Popular Western snacks can be enjoyed with coffee.

translations.source: Tí o bá fẹ́ àwọn ǹkan dídùn tó sì kún fún èròjà, gbìyànjú rẹ̀ wò ṣùgbọ́n ó dá lórí agbègbè bí Berliner, Pfannkuchen tàbí Krapfen.
translations.reference: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.
translations.hypothesis: If you enjoy sweet treats and pastries, you might be familiar with items like Berliner, Pfannkuchen, or Krapfen.

translations.source: Korri je isebe ti a se pelu ewe ati egbo, pelu okan ninu eran ati ewebe.
translations.reference: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
translations.hypothesis: Korry is a dish made with vegetables, herbs, and one type of meat or fish.

translations.source: kọrí lè ‘’gbẹ” tàbí kí ó “lómi” ó dá lórí iye om.
translations.reference: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.
translations.hypothesis: The price may be "fixed" or "negotiable."

translations.source: Ní ẹkùn abẹ́lé ti ìhà Àríwá India àti Pakistan, wọn a máa lo yúgọ̀tì̀ ninú kọrí; ni ọ̀pọ̀ ògbà; ni ìhà Gúsù India àti àwọn agbègbè coastal tó kù, omi àgbọn ní wọ́n sábà máa ń lò.
translations.reference: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
translations.hypothesis: In the northern regions of India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in cooking; it is also popular in various dishes. In the southern Indian states and coastal areas, however, coconut milk is more frequently used.

translations.source: Níbí a se ní láti yàn nínú erékùsù ẹgbẹ̀rín mẹ́tàdínlọ́gbọ̀n, oúnjẹ àwọn ènìyàn ilẹ̀ Indonisia ni ó jẹ́ àkórí fún gbogbo àwọn oúnjẹ agbèaè tí ó wà káakkiri orílẹ̀èdè náà.
translations.reference: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
translations.hypothesis: Here, we present a selection of three hundred and sixty Indonesian dishes, which represent the diverse culinary traditions found throughout the country.

translations.source: Sugbon ti a ba lo o laini alaye siwaju si, o ma n saba tumo si ounje iwase lati awon apa aaringbungbun ati ila oorun irekusu Java gangan.
translations.reference: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
translations.hypothesis: However, if we delve deeper into the details, we can see a clear connection to the culinary traditions of both the eastern and western regions of Java.

translations.source: Niisin ounje Jafa wa kaakiri asipelago, ekun re ni asayan ounje ti a se loso feere, awon ajasa ti o tayo julo je epa, ata, suga (paapa julo suga agbon) ati ajasa orisirisi.
translations.reference: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
translations.hypothesis: Jollof rice is a popular West African dish, and its key ingredient is rice cooked in a flavorful tomato-based sauce. The most common ingredients include tomatoes, peppers, onions, and sugar (often brown sugar), along with various other spices.

translations.source: Stirrups wa láti pèsè ìrànwọ́ fún èýkéyìí ẹsẹ̀ ẹni tí o ń wa kẹ̀kẹ́.
translations.reference: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
translations.hypothesis: Our stirrups are designed to provide excellent support for any foot size.

translations.source: Wọ́n sàgbékalẹ̀ ìdúró tó ga fún àwọn awakọ̀ àmọ́ wọ́n lè ní ààbò látarí pé ó se é se fáwọn awakọ̀ láti há sínú wọn.
translations.reference: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
translations.hypothesis: They installed a high fence around the swimming pool to prevent children from falling in.

translations.source: Bí wọ́n bá ju ẹni tó ń gun eṣin láti oríirẹ̀, à mó tí o fi ẹṣẹ̀ walẹ̀, wọ́n lè wọ́ tuurutu bí ẹṣin bá sálọ. Láti lè mún àdínkù bá ewu, ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ìlànà ààbò ni wọ́n lè gbé.
translations.reference: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.
translations.hypothesis: When someone is experiencing a headache, especially one that originates from the back of the head and radiates forward, they may also feel tension in their neck and shoulders. To help alleviate this discomfort, several techniques can be employed.

translations.source: Lákòókò ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn agunkèké máà n wọ bàtà gíga pèlú ìtèlè bàtà tọ dan tọ si tínrín.
translations.reference: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.
translations.hypothesis: In many cultures, women often wear high heels with straps that go around the ankle and up the shin.

translations.source: Lẹ́yìn náà, àwọn gààrì pàápàá jùlọ àwọn gààrì ilẹ̀ Geesi ní ọ̀pá ààbò tí ó fi ààyè sílẹ̀ fáwọ láti subú kúrò lórí gààrì bí olùwà tó fẹ́ subú bá fàá sẹ́yì.
translations.reference: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.
translations.hypothesis: Subsequently, the most common type of British currency, the pound sterling, was designed with a feature that allowed it to be easily torn in half, making it difficult for counterfeiters to replicate.

translations.source: Cochamó Valley - Gbajúgbajà òkè ni Chile, tí a tún mọ̀ sí Yosemite ti Gúsù Amẹ́ríkà, pẹ̀lú onírúurú ògiri akọ òkúta àti òkúta sóńsó.
translations.reference: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.
translations.hypothesis: Cochamo Valley - This mountainous region in Chile is often compared to Yosemite National Park in the United States, with its diverse array of granite peaks and forests.

translations.source: Àwọn òkè téńté pèlú àwọn ìwòye tó wúni lòrì láti àwọn igun tó ga lókẹ̀. Àwọn agùnkè láti gbogbo àgbáyé ń fi gbogbo ìgbà wá ọ̀nà titun láára àwọn ògìri.
translations.reference: Summits include breath-taking views from peaks. Climbers from all parts of the world are continually establishing new routes amongst its endless potential of walls.
translations.hypothesis: The tall trees are adorned with beautiful flowers that bloom from their high branches. People from all over the world are constantly discovering new and exciting flavors in the world of cuisine.

translations.source: Àwọn ẹrẹ́ ìdárayá orí yìnyìn ta án sọ̀kalẹ̀ láti orí òké, bíi fífò lóri yìnyìn àti wíwa ọkọ̀ lóri yìnyìn, wón gbajúmọ̀ tó ní ṣe pẹ̀lú pé eyàn a yọ́bọ̀ láti orí òkè tí yìnyìn ti bò pẹ̀lú skii tàbí bọ́ọ̀dì lábẹ́ ẹsẹ̀.
translations.reference: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
translations.hypothesis: The following are common causes of head injuries, including concussions and traumatic brain injuries, that often occur when a person falls from a height, such as slipping on ice or falling from a ladder.

translations.source: Fífò jẹ́ iṣẹ́ gbòógì fún ìrìn àjò pẹ̀lú ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn adárà tí ó sábàá má ń jẹ́ “ski bums” tí wọ́n gbìmọ̀ gbogbo ìsinmi yíká fífò ní àwọn ibùdó kan gbòógì.
translations.reference: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
translations.hypothesis: Skiing is a demanding sport that requires a high level of fitness, and many enthusiasts dedicate their entire lives to pursuing this passion, often living in remote areas to be close to the slopes.

translations.source: Ọjọ́ ti lọ lórí èrò yíyọ̀ lórí yìnyín — kíkun ihò ilẹ̀ sàfihàn àwọn arin yìnyín tó ti wà láti bí i 5000 BC!
translations.reference: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
translations.hypothesis: Today, we're exploring a fascinating topic that will take you back in time – to the ancient civilizations of the Middle East, some of which date back to 5000 BC!

translations.source: Ṣiṣe ski lati oke giga delẹ, ti wa gẹgẹ bi ere idaraya lati bii sẹnturi 17th ati pe ni 1861, awọn ara Nọwe da ẹgbẹ ski idaraya akọkọ ni Ọstrelia.
translations.reference: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
translations.hypothesis: Skiing, a sport that originated in mountainous regions, has a history dating back to the 17th century, and in 1861, Norwegians established the first ski club in Australia.

translations.source: Irinkiri pelu Apo agbekoyin lati owo Ski: Eto yi ni a tun da pe ni ski ti odi ilu, irinkiri ski tabi irinse ski.
translations.reference: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
translations.hypothesis: Skiing with an Aprés-Ski Outfit: This refers to wearing stylish and comfortable clothing suitable for relaxing and socializing after a day of skiing. It's often called "après-ski fashion."

translations.source: Ó farapẹ́ra ṣùgbọ́n ní ọ̀pọ̀ ìgbà kií lọ pẹ̀lú àrà ski alpine tàbí òkè gígùn, èyí tí ó kẹ́yìn máa wáye ní òkè tó ń yọ̀ tí ó sì nílò ohun tó tọ́ àti búùtù púpọ.
translations.reference: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
translations.hypothesis: While skiing can be exhilarating, it's important to remember that alpine skiing, in particular, often takes place on steep slopes and requires proper equipment and a high level of skill.

translations.source: Ronú ọ̀nà ìfò bí i ọ̀nà ìwàkè tí o mọ̀.
translations.reference: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
translations.hypothesis: Consider the path you take as a reflection of your character.

translations.source: Ní ipò tó dáa wàá lé de ibi tí ęsẹ̀ ò lè dé - ṣùgbọ́n kìí ṣe gbogbo ìgbà lo ma ri eré skiini kaa kiri ilu láìsí báàgì àgbékọ́ tó kún fún ojú ọ̀nà tí a ti ṣe lọ́ṣọ́.
translations.reference: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
translations.hypothesis: In some situations, it may seem like there's no way to get around – but it's not always necessary to take the most direct route. Sometimes, it's better to take a less obvious path, even if it means going around a problem.

translations.source: Yúróòpù jẹ àkójọpò àwọn orilé-ẹ̀dẹ tó kèrè jọjọ sùgbọn pèlú ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ orilé-ẹ̀dẹ olómìnira. Níwọn bí o ti yẹ kó rí, rírin ìrìn-àjò kàkàkiri ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ àwọn orilé-ẹ̀dẹ yìí túnmọ̀ sí gbígba ohun èlò ìwé ìwọ̀lú àti ìsàkóso ìwé ìrìnnà ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ ìgbá.
translations.reference: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
translations.hypothesis: Europe is a continent with a long and complex history, comprised of many independent countries. As you might expect, the borders of many of these countries have shifted significantly over time, often due to wars, treaties, and political changes.

translations.source: Agbegbe Sengeni, sugbon o n sise bii ilu oto ni owo yi.
translations.reference: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
translations.hypothesis: It's a small village, but it functions like a bustling city in this season.

translations.source: Nìwọ̀n ìgbà tí o bá dúró sí agbègbè yí, o lè rékọjá àwọn ẹnubodè láìsí àwọn àyẹ̀wò ìsakóso ìwé̀ ìrìnnà.
translations.reference: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
translations.hypothesis: During your stay in this area, you can access various resources without needing a library card.

translations.source: Bákanáà, nípa níní ìwé ìrìnnà Schengen , o kò nílò láti bèèrè fún ìwé ìrìnnà lọ sí àwọn orílẹ̀èdè tó jẹ́ ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Schengen lọ́ọ̀tọtọ̀, nítorínà, wàá lè pa àkókò, owó àti àwọn àkójọ ìwé mọ́.
translations.reference: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, with a Schengen visa, you don't need to apply for separate visas to travel to individual countries within the Schengen area, which can save you time, money, and paperwork.

translations.source: Kò sí ìtumọ̀ tí gbogbo èrò gbà àwọn ohun àkànṣe tí a lè pè ní ohun ini àtijọ́. Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ owó orí ma ń sọ pé àwọn ohun ìni tóti pẹ́ tó ọdún 100.
translations.reference: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
translations.hypothesis: There is no definitive answer to the question of what constitutes an antique. However, experts in the field generally agree that an item must be at least 100 years old.

translations.source: Àlàyé náà ní ìyàtọ̀ agbègbè, nibití ọjọ́ orí le kéré láwọn agbègbè bí i àríwá Amẹ́ríkà jú ti Yúròpù lọ.
translations.reference: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
translations.hypothesis: The climate varies significantly across regions, with some areas, such as parts of North America and Europe, experiencing shorter days.

translations.source: Àwọn àgbéjáde iṣk ọwọ́ ni a lè pè ní ẹ̀ṣọ́ ilé, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n kéré ju àwọn ọjà tó jọra wọn.
translations.reference: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
translations.hypothesis: Handheld computers, often called personal digital assistants (PDAs), are smaller than the larger computers they resemble.

translations.source: Sínsin ẹranko Reindeer jẹ́ pàtàkì sí ìgbésíayé àwọn Sami àti àṣà tó yí ìtajà ká náà se pàtàkì fọ́pọ̀ tó ní iṣẹ́ mìíràn.
translations.reference: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
translations.hypothesis: The reindeer is of great importance to the Sami people, and its role in their culture and way of life is incredibly significant, with many other functions as well.

translations.source: Kódà nínú ìse pàápàá, kìí se gbogbo Sami ló ti lọ́wọ́ nínú ọ̀sìn aládàńlá ẹranko reindeer, sùgbọ́n wọ́n ń gbé láti pípẹja, ọdẹ síse àti ohun tí ó jọ èyí , níní Reindeer gẹ́gẹ́ bí eranko ìpamọ́.
translations.reference: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.
translations.hypothesis: Even within the realm of fiction, not all stories about reindeer are entirely accurate. However, they often draw inspiration from real-life aspects, such as their resilience, their ability to navigate harsh environments, and their role as important animals in certain cultures. Reindeer, in reality, are fascinating creatures.

translations.source: Lóni ọ̀pọ̀ Sámì n ṣiṣẹ́ ní òwò ìgbàlódẹ́. Òwò ìbẹ̀wò jẹ́ owó pàtàkì tón wọlé ní Sapmi, agbègbè Sámì.
translations.reference: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.
translations.hypothesis: Today, many Sami people work in the reindeer herding industry. Reindeer herding is a vital economic activity in Sápmi, the Sami region.

translations.source: Lóòótọ́ ni pé wọ́n ń lò ó káàkiri, pàápàá láàárín àwọn tí kìí ṣe Romani, ọ̀rọ̀ yìí “Gypsy” ní wọ́n máa ń ri bí ọ̀rọ̀ àbùkù, nítorí bí o ti ṣe so pọ̀ mọ́ ìgbàgbọ́ àtọwọ́dọ́wọ́ tí kò dára àti ojúwòye tí kò tọ̀nà tí wọn fi ń wo àwọn ará Romani
translations.reference: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.
translations.hypothesis: It is true that the term "Gypsy" is often used to refer to the Romani people, but this word is considered offensive by many Romani individuals because it is associated with negative stereotypes and a history of discrimination against Romani communities.

translations.source: Ti orile ede ti o ba fe se abewo si ba je eyi ti won ti se imoran irin ajo fun, o le koba eto adojutofo ti ilera tabi ti fifagi le irinajo re.
translations.reference: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.
translations.hypothesis: If the language of the country you are traveling to is different from your own, you may want to consider purchasing a translation device or app for your trip.

translations.source: O tún lè fẹ́ láti bèèrè fún ìmọ̀ràn ìjọba yàtọ̀ sí tìrẹ, sùgbọ́n àmọ̀ràn wà fún àwọn ará ìlú.
translations.reference: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.
translations.hypothesis: It is also possible to request information from the government that is different from what is publicly available, but this information is often restricted to city residents.

translations.source: Fun apere, awon omo ilu Amerika ni Apa Ila Orun Arin le ni iriri to yato si ti awon ara Yuropi tabi Arabu.
translations.reference: As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs.
translations.hypothesis: For a short time, the people of North America experienced a different reality compared to those in Europe or the Arab world.

translations.source: Ìmọ̀ran jẹ̀ ìjúwé ránpé ọ̀rọ̀ òṣèlú ní ìlú.
translations.reference: Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country.
translations.hypothesis: The news report detailed a robbery that occurred in the city.

translations.source: Àwọn ìwòye tí wọ́n gbé kalẹ̀ lọ́pọ̀ ìgbà kì í kún tó, ó má ń jẹ́ ti gbogbogbò tàbí kó ti rọrùn jù tí a bá gbé e ti àwọn àlàyé tó kún rẹ́rẹ́ níbòmíràn.
translations.reference: The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
translations.hypothesis: Sometimes, old traditions are not suitable, or they are more easily adapted when understood through the lens of modern perspectives.

translations.source: Oju ọjọ́́ tomu gidi ni oruko ti a n pe gbogbo kàyéfì oju ojo to lewu to le fa ìjàmbá pupo, da àwùjọ rú, tàbí fa ìpàdánù ẹ̀mí.
translations.reference: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
translations.hypothesis: "Severe eye conditions" is the term used to describe all serious eye diseases that can cause significant vision loss, disability, or even death.

translations.source: Ojú ọjọ́ tóle lè Ṣẹlẹ̀ níbikíbi ní ayé ó dẹ̀ pé orísí o dá lórí bi agbègbè naa Ṣe rí, bí iyẹ̀pẹ̀ Ṣe rí àti bí afẹ́fẹ́ Ṣe rí.
translations.reference: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
translations.hypothesis: The weather today can vary greatly depending on the region, including temperature, humidity, and wind conditions.

translations.source: Iji lile, yinyin, ojo arooroda, ina inu papa jijo je orisi ona ti a fi n se afihan aida oju ojo, beeni ara sisan, efuufu, omi seleru ati afefe lile.
translations.reference: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
translations.hypothesis: Sunlight, moonlight, starlight, and the glow from a fire are all different ways that light is reflected and refracted, creating visual effects, illuminating objects, and influencing our perception of space, time, and even emotions.

translations.source: Agbègbè àti àkókò ojú ọjọ́ tó lágbára nínú èyí ti ìjì líle, yìnyín àti ìji eléruku wà.
translations.reference: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
translations.hypothesis: The region and time of day are important factors in determining the presence of mosquitoes and ticks.

translations.source: Wọ́n tí gba àwọn arìnrìn àjò ní mọ̀ràn láti ṣọ́ra fún ewu ojú ọja tó lè ní ipa ní agbègbè wọ́n nítorí ó lè ní ipa fún ènikẹni tó bá ní ètò láti rìnrìn àjò.
translations.reference: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any risk of severe weather affecting their area as they may affect any travel plans.
translations.hypothesis: They are issuing travel advisories with caution regarding potential risks in their region, as these risks could affect anyone planning to travel.

translations.source: Ẹnikẹ́ni tí ó bá ń gbèrò láti ṣeré lọ sí ìlú tí a lè pè ní ojú ogun gbọdọ̀ ní imọ̀ ọ̀tọ̀ gbá.
translations.reference: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.
translations.hypothesis: Anyone who is considering moving to a city known for its high crime rate should have a realistic understanding of the situation.

translations.source: Ìwárí lórí íntánẹ̀ẹ́tì fún 'ẹ̀kọ́ agbègbè' ma pèsè àdírksì ilé iṣẹ́ agbègbè.
translations.reference: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
translations.hypothesis: The internet has become an indispensable tool for "local education" and a vital resource for local businesses.

translations.source: Ètò ẹ̀kọ́ kan yíò kárí gbogbo ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tí wọ́n pẹ̀kẹ́lù níbí fún ẹ̀kúnrẹ́rẹ́ tó ga, lọ́pọ̀ ìgbà pẹ̀lú ìrírí oníse.
translations.reference: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
translations.hypothesis: This educational program covers all the essential topics in a comprehensive manner, often with a focus on practical application and real-world examples.

translations.source: Ẹ̀kọ́ ma n lọ fún ọjọ́ 2-5 o dẹ̀ ma n ní eré àpẹrẹ ṣíṣe, ìwòsàn àkókò púpọ̀ àti ẹkọ́ irin ogun nígbà miin.
translations.reference: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
translations.hypothesis: The training lasts for 2-5 days and includes practical exercises, intensive study sessions, and weapons training during free time.

translations.source: Àwọn ìwé àti ìwé magasini tó níṣe pẹ̀lú yíye aginju wọ́pọ̀ ṣúgà itejade tó níṣe pẹ̀lú agbègbè ogun ò pọ̀.
translations.reference: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
translations.hypothesis: Books and magazines that feature a significant amount of violence are less likely to be produced in areas with high levels of conflict.

translations.source: Àwọn arìnrìn àjò tí wọ́n ṣètò láti ṣe sex reassignment surgery ní òkè òkun ma ridájú pé wọ́n mú àwọn ìwé àkọsílẹ̀ tó péye dáni fún àti padà wálé.
translations.reference: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
translations.hypothesis: Travel agencies that organize sex reassignment surgeries have reportedly been found to be falsifying medical records and charging exorbitant prices.

translations.source: Ìmúrasílè àwọn ìjọba láti fàyè gba ìwẹ́ ìrinnà tí kò sàfihàn bóyá akọ yálà abo (X) tàbí àwọn ìwẹ isẹ́ tó pójúòsùwòn ní ìbámu pèlú orúko àti takọ-tabo yàtọ̀.
translations.reference: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
translations.hypothesis: Government regulations require that all packaging clearly indicate whether the product contains nuts (X) or other allergens, along with a list of ingredients and relevant information.

translations.source: Ìfẹ́ ìjọba ilẹ̀ òkèrè láti yẹ́ ìwé àṣẹ yìí sí kìí ṣe nǹkan bàbàr.
translations.reference: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
translations.hypothesis: The government's decision to grant this license is not a trivial matter.

translations.source: Ṣíṣe àyẹ̀wò ní ibi ìdádúró àwọn ọlọ́pàá náà ti wá di àyọjúràn gbáà in sáà ọjọ́ kọkànlá, lẹ́yìn – osù kọkànlá, ọdún 2001.
translations.reference: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
translations.hypothesis: The police station where the incident occurred was located in a rural area, on the evening of December 26th, 2001.

translations.source: Àwọn èèyàn tó ń dúró fún iṣẹ́ abẹ ìpàrọ̀ ẹ̀dá má se retí àti kọjá ẹ̀rọ àyẹ̀wò pẹ̀lú iyì àti àdámọ́ wọn.
translations.reference: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
translations.hypothesis: People waiting for the creative writing competition should be patient and avoid using any prohibited devices.

translations.source: Ìjì omi jẹ́ ṣíṣàn omi tó n padà láti ríru omi tó já bò láti etí ọ̀sà, sába ní rífù àbí bákanáà.
translations.reference: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
translations.hypothesis: Spring water is water that emerges from the ground, typically from a spring or well.

translations.source: Torí topọ́lọ́jì abẹ́ omi ṣíṣàn padàwá dárogún sí àwọn apá kán tó jìn, ṣíṣàn tó ṣe kía lọ sí omi jíjìn lè dáwà síbẹ̀.
translations.reference: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
translations.hypothesis: Due to the increasing water pollution, the amount of water reaching the coastal areas is decreasing, which could have negative consequences for the marine ecosystem.

translations.source: Agara látàrí ìgbìyànjú láti lúwẹ̀ pada ṣẹ́yìn, ní ẹ̀yí tó ṣe é́ ṣe kó se okùnfà ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn ikú.
translations.reference: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
translations.hypothesis: The lottery is a dangerous game that can lead to addiction and financial ruin for many people.

translations.source: Ní kẹ́tẹ́ ti o ba ti kúrò nínú ìjì, wíwẹ odò padà kí jé ìnira mo lọ̀pọ́ ìgbà.
translations.reference: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
translations.hypothesis: After leaving the hospital, I often felt a wave of relief wash over me.

translations.source: Gbìyànjú kí o fi ojú sun ibìkan tí wọ́n kò ti ní ká ọ mọ́ tàbí lórí ipa rẹ àti lórí bóyá wọ́n lè se àkíyèsí rẹ, o lè dúró fún ìdóòlà.
translations.reference: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.
translations.hypothesis: It is important to be patient and understanding when dealing with someone you don't know well, or when you are unsure of their intentions or how they might react. Patience can be a virtue.

translations.source: Àtún gbéwọlé lójijì ma ń tètè wáyé ju ǹkan òjijì lọ (abala ìgbádùn lẹ́yìn ìgbeyàwó kò pọ̀) ó ma ń pẹ́, ò sì ma ń le.
translations.reference: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
translations.hypothesis: These days, I'm feeling more tired than usual (the post-wedding bliss seems to have faded), I'm less energetic, and I'm finding it harder to concentrate.

translations.source: Àwọn arìnrìnàjò tó rọrùn fún láti sàmúnlò àṣà tuntun, nígbà míràn wọ́n má a ni àkókò lile láti lè sàmúnlò àṣà ìbílẹ̀.
translations.reference: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
translations.hypothesis: Some people are quick to embrace new trends, while others prefer to stick with traditional customs.

translations.source: Bi o se n pada lo ile leyin to ti gbe oke okun, o ti yiwa pada si asa titun o de ti padanu awon isesi re to wa lati asa ile re.
translations.reference: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
translations.hypothesis: After returning home from the seaside, she gradually adapted to her new life and overcame the feelings of homesickness she had experienced.

translations.source: Tí o bá lọ sí ilẹ̀ òkèrè fún ìgbà àkọ́kọ́, àwọn ènìyàn lè ṣe sùúrù pẹ̀lú ẹ, nítorí wọn mọ̀ pé àwọn arìnrìnàjò ní orílẹ̀ èdè tuntun nílò láti farasinl.
translations.reference: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
translations.hypothesis: When you travel to a new country for the first time, people might be surprised by you, because they know that people from different cultures need time to adjust.

translations.source: Àwọn ènìyàn lè má ms pé ṣùúrù àti ìmọ̀ jẹ́ ǹkan pàtàkì fún àwọn tó rìnrìn àjò bọ̀ wá sílẹ̀.
translations.reference: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
translations.hypothesis: People often believe that being calm and knowledgeable is important for travelers to have a good experience.

translations.source: Ìró pírámìdì àti àfihàn iná jẹ́ òkan lára àwọn ǹkan tó múnú àwọn ọmọdẹ́ dùn jù lágbàgbẹ̀ yí.
translations.reference: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
translations.hypothesis: Pyramids and magic tricks are among the things that fascinate children the most.

translations.source: O lè rí àwọn pírámìdì yìí nínú òkùnkùn o sì tún le rí wọn ní ídákérọ́rọ́ kí eré náà tó bẹ̀rẹ̀ .
translations.reference: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
translations.hypothesis: You can see these pyramids in the dark, and you can also see them clearly just before the game starts.

translations.source: O ma ń gbọ́ ìró àwọn oníràn afẹ́ àtàwọn òǹtàjà. Ìtàn ohun àti iná dàbi ìwé ìtàn.
translations.reference: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
translations.hypothesis: I enjoy listening to the stories of dreamers and entrepreneurs. Their experiences and the creation of their businesses are inspiring and make for great stories.

translations.source: Sphinx ni a lò fi se ìtàgé àti olùsọ ìtàn tó gùn.
translations.reference: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
translations.hypothesis: The sphinx is a mythical creature often depicted as a symbol of wisdom and a guardian of secrets.

translations.source: Àfihàn àwọn ìwòye di mímọ̀ lórí àwọnn pírámìdì àti wípé onírúurú pírámìdì ma ń tan iná sóke.
translations.reference: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
translations.hypothesis: The secrets of the pyramids are being revealed, and it is believed that various pyramids were used to generate electricity.

translations.source: Erekuṣu Guusu Shetland, eyi ti a ṣe awari rẹ ni 1819, ni ọpọlọpọ orilẹ ede sọ wipe awọn ni awọn ni ti wọn si ni ipile ti o pọ ju, pẹlu bi mẹrindinlogun ṣe n ṣiṣẹ ni 2020.
translations.reference: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
translations.hypothesis: The South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several countries, and their territorial extent remains a subject of dispute, with approximately 80% being claimed by the United Kingdom as of 2020.

translations.source: Awon asipelago wan i 120 km apa Arewa Peninsula. Irekusu Oba Jooji to tobi ju wa ni ile Ile Nla La Estrelasi.
translations.reference: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
translations.hypothesis: The archipelago is located 120 km north of the mainland. The largest island is Great Isle, which is part of the Estrelasi archipelago.

translations.source: Apeere awon omiran je Irekusu Livinstini ati Etan ibi yi kldera fokeno to si n sise pese ebute abayeda to je iyalenu.
translations.reference: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
translations.hypothesis: The recent events in Liechtenstein and this region are truly concerning and represent a significant challenge.

translations.source: Ile Eliswori ni ile to wa ni apa guusu Irekusu, tii Okun Belingisausini yika.
translations.reference: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
translations.hypothesis: The Eliswori settlement is located in the southern part of Irekusu, near the Belingisausini River.

translations.source: Àwọn òkè ilẹ̀ Peninsula ti darapọ̀ di to ní ìpele, ó tún wá parapọ̀ di òkè alásopọ̀ ti oníkìlómítà ọ̀tàlélọ́dọ̀ọ́rún ti àwọn òkè Elisworth, èyí tí Minnesota Glacier pín sí méjì.
