translations.reference: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
translations.hypothesis: The peninsula's ridges have merged into a single, prominent ridge that forms the eastern edge of the Ellsworth Mountains, effectively dividing the Minnesota Glacier into two parts.

translations.source: Ní apá Àríwá tàbí Sentinel Range ni Antarctica tí ó jẹ́ àwọn òkè tí ó ga jù, Vinson Massif, ga to ìwọ̀n maili ọ̀rìnlé ní ẹgbẹ̀rún mẹ́rin àti méjìléláàdórùn ún Òke Vinson.
translations.reference: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
translations.hypothesis: In the northern, or Sentinel Range, part of Antarctica, which includes the highest peaks, is the Vinson Massif, with Mount Vinson reaching a height of approximately 16,050 feet.

translations.source: Ní àwọn ìgbèríko láìsí ẹ̀rọ alágbèéká, fóònù ẹ̀rọ sátálàìtì lè jẹ́ ọ̀nà kan ṣoṣo fún ọ.
translations.reference: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
translations.hypothesis: In situations where technology is unavailable, a satellite phone can be the only way to communicate.

translations.source: Ero ibanisoro oni satelaiti ko wa lati dipo ero ibanisoro adagbe nigbagbogbo, nitori pe o ni lati wa nita gbangba koo de ma foju ri satelaiti bayi, ki o to le fi pe.
translations.reference: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
translations.hypothesis: Satellite-based navigation systems cannot always replace traditional navigation methods, because they require a clear line of sight to the satellites in order to function properly.

translations.source: Ìgbọ́jàlọ ló ma ń lo ìpèsè náà dáadáá, pẹ̀lú pleasure craft, àti ìrín àjò tó ní détà àti ohùn.
translations.reference: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
translations.hypothesis: The boat is well-equipped, featuring a comfortable cabin, as well as a powerful engine and excellent handling.

translations.source: O ye ki alamojuto ero ibanisoro re ni agbegbe ibile re le fun o ni alaye to kuna nipa lilo eto won.
translations.reference: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
translations.hypothesis: It is important to consult with experts in your local community who can provide you with comprehensive information about the use of these systems.

translations.source: Àwọn ohun tí àwọn ènìyàn ń ṣe jùlọ̀ báyìí, ìyẹn fún ẹni tí ó bá ní ìpinnu láti ní ìsinmi àárín ọdún ní láti rín ìrìn àjò, kó sì kẹ́kọ̀ọ.
translations.reference: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
translations.hypothesis: These days, the most common thing people do, especially for those planning a mid-year vacation, is to book flights and accommodations.

translations.source: Èyí ló gbajúmọ̀ jù láàrin àwọn tó ti fi iléẹ̀kọ́ sílẹ̀, èyí tó fún wọn láàyè àti gba ààyè ọdún kan sáájú iléẹ̀kọ́ gíga fásitì,láláì gbégirénà ètò ẹ̀kọ́ wọn.
translations.reference: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
translations.hypothesis: This is a common challenge among graduates, as they transition from the structured environment of education into the realities of the working world, often facing a steep learning curve and adapting to new demands in their chosen fields.

translations.source: Ni opolopo igba, fifi oruko sile fun iwe kika olodun kan ni ilu oba le je ona si igbega lati koja si ile iwe giga nigba to ba pada si orile’de abinibi re.
translations.reference: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
translations.hypothesis: Often, securing a scholarship for a year of study in a foreign country can be a crucial step towards gaining admission to a university when returning to one's home country.

translations.source: Lóní déédé, owó ikẹ́ẹ̀kẹ́ yíò wà lórí àwọn ètò ẹ̀kọ́ wọ̀nyí.
translations.reference: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
translations.hypothesis: Specifically, this funding will be allocated to these educational programs.

translations.source: Finlandi jẹ ibi tó dára fún wíwa ọkọ̀ ojú omi. Ilẹ̀ tó ní ègbègbé odò kékeré ó ní ègbegbè irékùsù náà, ní àwọn odò kékeré àti ní asipelago elété omi.
translations.reference: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
translations.hypothesis: Finland is a wonderful place for sailing. The country, with its numerous lakes and waterways, offers a vast network of navigable waters, including lakes, rivers, and archipelagos.

translations.source: Nínu archipelagos àti lakes, o kò fi taratara nílò yacht.
translations.reference: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
translations.hypothesis: In archipelagos and lakes, a yacht is not necessarily the fastest option.

translations.source: Lóòótọ́, àwọn etí òkun archipelagos àti omi adágún tó tóbi jùlọ tóbi lóòótọ́ fún ọkọ̀ ìgbafẹ́ ojú omi, àwọn ọkọ̀ ojú omi kéékèké tàbí pé ó ń pèsè ìrírí ọ̀tọ̀.
translations.reference: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
translations.hypothesis: Indeed, the archipelagos and large bodies of water are essential for maritime transport, small boats, or simply for enjoying the beauty of the sea.

translations.source: Wíwọ ọkọ̀-ojú omi jẹ ìsẹẹsí àsèyìnwá ní Orílè-èdè Finland, pèlú ọkọ̀-ojú omi kan si ènìyàn mẹjẹ tàbí mẹjọ.
translations.reference: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
translations.hypothesis: Swimming is a popular recreational activity in Finland, with one swimming pool for every two to four people.

translations.source: Èyí sẹ déédéé pẹ̀lú ilẹ̀ Norway, Sweden àti New Zealand, àmó ó jẹ́ alílẹ́gbé (fún àpẹẹrẹ bí nọ́mbà Netherlands nàa jé ọkan sí ọgójì).
translations.reference: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
translations.hypothesis: This is consistent with the practices in Norway, Sweden, and New Zealand, but it is more restrictive (for example, the Netherlands has a ratio of one to two).

translations.source: Púpọ̀ nínú àwọn àpẹrẹ gbòógi ọkọ̀ ìgbafẹ ojú omi Baltic ni àlékún ìdúró ní St. Petersburg, Russia.
translations.reference: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
translations.hypothesis: Many of the iconic cruise ships that sail the Baltic Sea have a docking station in St. Petersburg, Russia.

translations.source: Eyi tumọ si wipe o le lọ ri ilu onitan naa fun ọjọ meji dọgba to ba de waa pada ninu ọkọ oju omi lalẹ ti o tun maa sun sibẹ.
translations.reference: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
translations.hypothesis: This means that you could visit the coastal city for two days and return on the same evening by taking a ferry that also makes the trip.

translations.source: Bí o bá má ń lo apwọn ohun ìrìnnà ojú omi nìkan lọ sí ìlà omi, o kò ní lílò ìwé ìrìnnà mọ̀tọ̀. (fún ọdún 2009.
translations.reference: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
translations.hypothesis: If you are only using sunscreen to protect your skin from the sun, you don't need to use a separate moisturizer. (For the year 2009.)

translations.source: Àwọn ọkọ̀ ìgbafẹ́ ojú omi sàfihàn ìlú Berlin, Germany nínú ìwé ìléwọ́. Gẹ́gẹ́ bí o ti ríi nínú áwòrán atọ́ka ayé, Ìlú Berlin kò sí ní agbègbè òkun àti pé ìbẹ̀wò sí ìlú náà kò sí nínú owó ọkọ̀ ojú omi.
translations.reference: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
translations.hypothesis: The map of Berlin, Germany, in the travel guide clearly shows that the city is not located near the ocean, and there are no ferry routes to the city.

translations.source: Ìriìn àjò nínú ọkọ̀ òfuruufú lẹ jẹ ìrírí ìjayà fún èyàn lóórẹkóórẹ, pàápàá júlọ tó bá jẹ pé wọn kò tìí fò télè tàbí wọn ti ní ìrírí tó banilérù.
translations.reference: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
translations.hypothesis: Motion sickness in cars is a common problem, especially for those who are prone to it or who are experiencing severe symptoms.

translations.source: Kìi ṣe nkan ojútíti: kò yàtọ̀ sí àwọn ẹ̀rù bíbà àti ìkórira tí àwọn èyàn púpọ̀ ma n ní.
translations.reference: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.
translations.hypothesis: It's not a simple matter: it's different from the usual problems and difficulties that people face.

translations.source: Fún àwọn kan ẹ̀kọ nípa bí àwọn ọkọ̀ ofurufu kan ṣe má n ṣiṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú nkan tó ma n ṣẹ́lẹ̀ nígbàtí ó n fò, lè bá wọn ṣẹ́gun ẹ̀rù bíbà tí ìpilẹ̀ rẹ̀ jẹ́ nkan àìmọ̀ tàbi àìlèṣàkóso.
translations.reference: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
translations.hypothesis: For some people, learning about how airplanes work, especially when they're experiencing turbulence, can alleviate their anxiety or fear.

translations.source: Àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ tó ń fi ọjà/ẹrù ránṣẹ́ maha ń pa owó iyebíye láti fi nǹkan ránṣẹ́ ní kíakía. Lọ́pọ̀ ìgbà àsìkò ṣe pàtàkì púpọ̀ pẹ́lù àwọn ìwé ìdókowò, ọjà tàbí àwọn ẹ̀yà ara tí wọ́n fi tún nǹkan ṣe ní kíákíá.
translations.reference: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.
translations.hypothesis: Companies that sell products or services often use packaging to send items to customers. Sometimes, the packaging itself is important, especially when it comes to books, luxury goods, or items that need to be protected.

translations.source: Ní àwọn òpópónà kan, àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ ńlánlá ní ọkọ̀ ojú òfurufú wọn, ṣùgbọ́n ní àwọn òpópónà míràn àti ní àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ kékèké, wàhálà wà.
translations.reference: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.
translations.hypothesis: In some areas, large companies have good reputations, but in other areas and in smaller businesses, there are problems.

translations.source: Tí wọ́n bá fi ǹkan ránṣẹ́ nípa lílo ọkọ̀ òfurufú, ní àwọn ọ̀nà kan o lè gbà ọjọ́ díẹ̀ láti gbà ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn ọlọ́pàá ojú ọ̀nà ìrìn àjò.
translations.reference: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.
translations.hypothesis: When someone sends a message about using a motorcycle, it might take a few days for it to reach the relevant authorities in the transportation sector.

translations.source: Ona kan soso ti a le fi tete gbe wa ni ki a firanse gege bii eru ti won ti yewo. Awon ofin oko ofurufu o ni je ka fi eru ranse lai si onirinajo, ibe ni iwo ti ma buy.
translations.reference: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
translations.hypothesis: One of the first things we can do is to treat each other with respect, like we would treat valuable objects. The laws of the universe are clear: if you treat something with disrespect, it will eventually reflect back to you.

translations.source: Ọ̀nà tí ó hànde jù láti gbé ọkọ̀ ojú òfúrufú fò ní kílàsì àkọ́kọ́ tàbí to ní olókoòwò ni láti mún owó tó jọjú jáde fún àǹfàní náà (tàbí èyí tí ó dára jù ni kí ó jẹ́ kí ilé iṣẹ́ rẹ̀ kó bá a se).
translations.reference: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
translations.hypothesis: The easiest way for a taxi driver to accept a fare is for the meter to automatically calculate and display the total amount due (or, ideally, for the company to have a system in place to do this).

translations.source: Síbèsíbè, èyí kò jẹ olówó póókú: gẹ́gẹ́ bí òfin oríowó, ní ìrètí làti san tó ìlọ́pó mẹrin ówó ìrinàjò mèúnù fún ti onísòwò, áti ìlọ́po mọ́kànlá fún ìpín kínní.
translations.reference: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
translations.hypothesis: Certainly, this is not a cheap option: according to the regulations, the expected cost is approximately forty thousand naira for the transportation of the deceased, and a further sum for the coffin.

translations.source: Lákòótán, kòsí ǹkankan nínu wíwá ẹ̀dínwó fún òwò tàbí ìjókòó olówó ńlá ní ọkọ̀ òfurufù tó ń lọ tààrà láti A sí B.
translations.reference: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
translations.hypothesis: Unfortunately, there is no information available in the provided text regarding the cost or fare for a high-speed train traveling from point A to point B.

translations.source: Àwọn ilẹ́ isẹ́ ọkọ̀ òfurufú mọ̀ dájú wípẹ́ àwọn ẹgbẹ́ arìnrìn àjò òfurufú tí wọ́n setán láti san ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ owó dọ́là fún ànfànì láti dẹ ibikíbi ní kíákíá àti pèlú ìrọ̀rùn, wọn si máà n gba ìdẹ́yẹlẹ́ tó bójúmu.
translations.reference: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
translations.hypothesis: Luxury car dealerships are increasingly offering financing options to customers, allowing them to purchase expensive vehicles with ease and convenience, often with attractive terms.

translations.source: Ìpínlẹ̀ Moldova jẹ́ Chisinau. Èdè abínibí wọn ni Romanian, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n ma ń lo èdè Russia jù.
translations.reference: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
translations.hypothesis: The capital of Moldova is Chisinau. The official language is Romanian, but Russian is also widely spoken.

translations.source: Moldova jẹ olómìnira ílu tó ní ọ̀pọ̀ èyà tí o tí dojúkọ ìjà ẹléyàmẹ̀yà.
translations.reference: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
translations.hypothesis: Moldova is a country that has experienced a number of conflicts.

translations.source: Ní ọdún 1994, ìjà yìí yọrí sí ìdásílẹ̀ ilẹ̀ olómìnira Transnistrialẹ́kùn gúúsù Moldova, èyí tó ní ìjọba tara rẹ̀ àti owó wọn, àmọ́ orílẹ̀ tó jẹ́ ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ àjọ UN.
translations.reference: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
translations.hypothesis: In 1994, this conflict led to the establishment of the breakaway republic of Transnistria, located in the eastern part of Moldova. This entity has its own government and currency, despite being part of a country that is a member of the United Nations.

translations.source: Àtúnṣe ti wà fún okùn tó so ètò ọrọ̀ ajé ọnà méjì tí Moldova pín sí, láìbìkítà nípa pé ìṣòro ìdúnàdúrà òṣèlú wà nílẹ̀.
translations.reference: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
translations.hypothesis: The analysis of the two economic policies implemented by Moldova focuses on the impact of the steel industry's decline on the country.

translations.source: Ẹ̀sìn gbòógì tó wà ní Moldova ni ẹ̀sìn kìrìsìsítíẹ́nì elérò tótọ́.
translations.reference: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
translations.hypothesis: The most common type of wine produced in Moldova is dry white wine.

translations.source: Ismir ni ìlú tó Tobi jùlọ ní Toki pẹ̀lú èyàn bíi mílíọ́nù 3.7, o ní ebute tó tóbi jù lẹ́yìn Istanbuli àti ile iṣẹ́ ìrìn àjò tó dáa.
translations.reference: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
translations.hypothesis: Izmir is the largest city in Turkey, with a population of approximately 3.7 million. It has the second-largest port in Turkey and a major railway hub.

translations.source: Nígbà àtijó ìlú Smyrna, ní báyìí ó jẹ ibùdó ìgbàlódé, ìdàgbàsókè tí o kún fún ìṣòwò, tí a yíká pẹ̀lú omi àti àwọn òkè.
translations.reference: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
translations.hypothesis: In ancient times, the city of Smyrna, now a modern metropolis, was a thriving port city known for its trade, surrounded by water and hills.

translations.source: Àwọn boulevard to fe, ile ti o ni jigi ni iwaju ati oja igbalode ni a fi aja oni taili pupa seso won, oja senturi kejìdílógún, ati awon mọ́ṣáláṣí ati ṣọ́ọ̀si, biotilejepe ilu naa ni afefe to ile Yuropi Mediteraniani ju ile Turkeyi ibile lo.
translations.reference: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
translations.hypothesis: The city boasts beautiful boulevards, houses with charming facades, and a vibrant marketplace. It also features a second-hand goods market, as well as various shops and restaurants, giving it a more European Mediterranean feel than a traditional Turkish atmosphere.

translations.source: Abúlé Haldarsvikṣe àfihàn ìwòye nítòsí erékùsù Eysturoy o sì tún ní ilé ìjọsìn onígun mẹjọ tí kò̀ wọ́pọ̀.
translations.reference: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.
translations.hypothesis: The Haldarsvik farmstead, located in the municipality of Eysturoy, also features a historic church with ten altars, which is quite unique.

translations.source: Ní àgbàlá ilé ìjọsìn, àwọn àwòrán dídán tò ní àdàbà tó yani lẹ́nu wà lórí àwọn ibojì kan.
translations.reference: In the churchyard, there are interesting marble sculptures of doves over some tombs.
translations.hypothesis: In the church building, there were several framed pictures with intricate designs hanging on the walls.

translations.source: O tó ìdajì wákàtí kan láti rin abúlé ìyàlénu já.
translations.reference: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.
translations.hypothesis: It took only a moment to reach the house of sorrow.

translations.source: Sí àríwá àti láàrín àwọn ibi tí kò nù ni a ti rí ìlú Sintra tí ó rẹwà fún ìfẹ́ tí ó sì jẹ ojú ní gbèsè, ní èyí tí ó di gbajúgbajà fún àwọn ènìyàn láti ilẹ̀ òkèrè lẹ́yìn tí Lord Byron kọ nípa rẹ.
translations.reference: To the north and within easy reach is the romantic and fascinating town of Sintra and which was made famous to foreigners after a glowing account of its splendours recorded by Lord Byron.
translations.hypothesis: Located in the north and among the most beautiful places in Portugal, the city of Sintra is a place of wonder and enchantment, attracting many visitors from around the world ever since Lord Byron wrote about it.

translations.source: Boosi Skotobi 403 ma n rin irin ajo deede lo si Sintra o ma n duro ni Kabo da Roka.
translations.reference: Scotturb Bus 403 travels regularly to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.
translations.hypothesis: Bus number 403 is making its regular trip to Sintra and will be stopping at Cabo da Roca.

translations.source: Ẹ̀wẹ̀, sàbẹ̀wò sí ẹkùn àríwá ni ilé ìsìn Our Lady of Fatima (ojúbọ), ibi tó gbajúmọ̀ káàkiri àgbáyé fún nnkan abàmì.
translations.reference: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.
translations.hypothesis: Yes, a visit to the northern part of the Our Lady of Fatima shrine (nearby) is a popular destination for pilgrims from all over the world.

translations.source: Jọ̀wọ́ rántí pé ó pandandan kí o ṣàbẹ̀wò sí ilé ìsìnkú tó tóbí, bí ilẹ̀ tó ní ìtumọ̀ sí abala àwọn ènìyàn tó wà ní ilé ayé.
translations.reference: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
translations.hypothesis: Please remember that it is important to visit large cemeteries, as they hold significance for the people who live in this world.

translations.source: Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ọkùnrin àti obìnrin ló sì wà láyé tí wọ́n móríye àkókò wọn níbí, àti ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn mìíràn tí wọ́n ní àwọn olólùfẹ́ wọ́n tí wọ́n sekúpa tàbí tí wọ́n siṣẹ́ kú níbẹ̀, àwọn Jew àti àwọn tí kìí se Jew rí bákanáà.
translations.reference: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
translations.hypothesis: Many men and women around the world know their place of origin, and many others have loved ones who have passed away or who still live there, whether they are Jewish or not.

translations.source: Jọ̀wọ́ fi tọ̀wọ̀tọ̀wọ̀ ṣe pẹlú ilẹ̀ náà, pẹ̀lẹ́pẹ̀lẹ́, sùúrù àti ọ̀wọ̀. Ẹ má ṣe fi Holocaust tàbí Nazis ṣe yẹ̀yẹ.
translations.reference: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
translations.hypothesis: Please treat the country with respect, dignity, and kindness. Do not glorify the Holocaust or the Nazis.

translations.source: Máṣe bá ojú òpó náà jẹ́ nípa ṣíṣà mí si tàbí àwòrán tó wà ní ogiri.
translations.reference: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
translations.hypothesis: Please don't stare at my eyes or the picture on the wall.

translations.source: Àwọn èdè ìṣẹ́ Barcelona ní Catalan àti Spanish. Bí ìdajì wọn ló fẹ́ràn láti sọ Catalan, ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ló mọ èdè náà , àti wípé gbogbo ènìyàn ló fẹ́ ẹ̀ mọ èdè Spain.
translations.reference: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
translations.hypothesis: The official languages of Barcelona are Catalan and Spanish. While many people prefer to speak Catalan, a significant number also speak the language, and everyone is expected to know Spanish.

translations.source: Ṣùgbọ́n púpọ̀ nínú àwọn ìkìlọ̀ ní wọ́n fi Katalani kọ torí oun ní òfin kọ́kọ́ fi ṣe ede gbendek.
translations.reference: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
translations.hypothesis: There are many criticisms of the way Catalan was initially standardized, particularly regarding its relationship to the Castilian language.

translations.source: Béèni èdè Spaniṣi ni wọ́n lò ní ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ ti ìjọba àti àwọn ohun èlò míìn.
translations.reference: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
translations.hypothesis: Spanish is the official language used in the government and various industries.

translations.source: Èdè catalan nìkan ni wọ́n máa fi ń ṣe ìkéde lásán ní agbègbè, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn ìkéde pàjáwìrì ni wọ́n máa n ṣe pẹlú oríṣìíríṣìí èdè bí i Spanish, English, French, Arabic àti Japanes.
translations.reference: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
translations.hypothesis: While Catalan is the only language commonly used for official communication in the region, a variety of other languages are also present, including Spanish, English, French, Arabic, and Japanese.

translations.source: A mọ Parisian fún orúkọ ,bí wọ́n ṣe jẹ́ aláìlẹ́kọ̀ọ́ wọ́n sì tùn ní ìgbéraga.
translations.reference: Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant.
translations.hypothesis: I know Parisians by reputation; they are known for being sophisticated and demanding.

translations.source: Níwọ̀n ìgbà tí èyí kìí se ìwòye tó se déédéé ní gbogbo ìgbà, ọ̀nà tó dára jùlọ láti sẹ dáradára ní Paris ni láti jé ọmọlúwàbí ní ìhùwàsí bí ẹni tó gbẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ ilé. Èyí máa jẹ kí lílọ káàkiri seése ní ìrọrùn.
translations.reference: While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier.
translations.hypothesis: While this may not always be the case, the best way to experience Paris is often to immerse yourself in the city like a local. This means exploring the neighborhoods on foot and taking your time.

translations.source: Abuku gbangba awon ara Parisia ni yio poora ti o ba ni awon iwe iteriba kookan.
translations.reference: Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies.
translations.hypothesis: A comprehensive guide for Parisians will include information on every important aspect of the city.

translations.source: Ọgbà Ìdárayá Ìlú ti Odò Plitfisi kún fún igbó pẹ̀lú ẹ̀gbẹ́ omi, igi sprusi àti igi fígì àti àdàpọ̀ ewé Alpini àti Mẹditereniani.
translations.reference: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.
translations.hypothesis: The city of Plettenberg-Bay is known for its forests, which are home to a variety of plant life, including spruce trees, fig trees, and the alpine and Mediterranean flora.

translations.source: A Ṣàkíyèsí púpọ̀ pe ọ̀pọ̀ ayika ewe nítorí maikroklaimeeti rẹ̀ tó pọ̀, yẹ̀pẹ̀ tó yàtọ̀ ati ìṢesí afẹ́fẹ́.
translations.reference: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
translations.hypothesis: It is widely believed that many plant species are endangered due to their high demand, illegal harvesting, and habitat loss.

translations.source: Agbègbè náà jẹ́ bí ilé fún àwọn ẹranko àti ẹye.
translations.reference: The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species.
translations.hypothesis: That area is like a home for animals and birds.

translations.source: Àwọn ẹranko tí kò wọ́pọ̀ bí i ti béárì aláwọ̀ búráwùn, ìkokò, idì, òwìwí, ológìnní ijù àti capercaillie ti ilẹ̀ Europe la lè rí pẹ̀lú àwọn ẹ̀yà ẹranko tó wọ́pọ̀ míràn.
translations.reference: Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
translations.hypothesis: Certain bird species, such as the brown owl, cuckoo, thrush, finch, jay, and capercaillie of Europe, can be found alongside other, more common bird species.

translations.source: Lákòkò àbẹ̀wò síléègbé àwọn mọ́ǹkì, wọ́n ní káwọn obìnrin wọ yẹ̀rì tó bòwọ́n lẹ́sẹ̀, kí wọ́n sì bo èjìká wọn pẹ̀lú.
translations.reference: While visiting the monasteries, women are required to wear skirts covering the knees and have their shoulders covered, too.
translations.hypothesis: During the period of mourning for the deceased, it is customary for women to wear dark clothing and to cover their heads.

translations.source: Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ilẹ́ ìdáwà máà n pẹ̀sẹ̀ asọ ìrọ̀rùn fún àwọn obìnrin tí o ba mùra dada sìlẹ ki wọn tọ wá, sùgbọn ti o bá mú tirẹ lọwọ, paapaa julọ eyi to ni awọ didan, ẹrin in arakunrin tabi arabinrin yo fi gba ọ wole lẹnu ọna.
translations.reference: Most of the monasteries do provide wraps for women who come unprepared, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you'll get a smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.
translations.hypothesis: Many gift shops sell beautiful clothes for women, but even the most attractive dresses, whether they are colorful, elegant, or casual, will likely end up gathering dust in the closet.

translations.source: Ní ọ̀rọ̀ kánáà, wọ́n ti ní káwọn ọkùnrin má a wọ ṣòkòtò tó bó orúnkún wọn.
translations.reference: Along the same line, men are required to wear trousers covering the knees.
translations.hypothesis: In those days, men used to wear socks that reached their knees.

translations.source: Èyí náà lè jẹ́ yíyá nínú àkójọ tó wà ní ẹnu ọ̀nà àmọ́ wọn kò fọ àwọn aṣọ wọ̀nyí nígbà tí wọ́n lò ó tán, ara rẹ lé má se dáradára láti wọ́ àwọn yẹ̀rì yìí. Ọ̀kan ti se rẹ́gí fáwọn ọkùnrin!
translations.reference: This too can be borrowed from the stock at the entrance but that clothing isn't washed after every user so you may not feel comfortable wearing these skirts. One size fits all for men!
translations.hypothesis: This could be a scandal within their community, as these clothes were likely worn until they were completely worn out, and it's not appropriate for someone of their status to wear such things. One of them is even a man!

translations.source: Ìlànà ìdáná àwọn Majorcan bí i ti àwọn tó wà ní agbègbè omi, ló dá lórí búrẹ́dì, ẹ̀fọ́ àti ẹran (pàápàá jùlọ ẹran ẹlẹ́dẹ̀), tí wọ́n si ma ń lo òróró ólìfù.
translations.reference: Majorcan cuisine, like that of similar zones in the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (specially pork), and uses olive oil throughout.
translations.hypothesis: The traditional diet of the Majorcan people, like that of other coastal communities, is based on bread, vegetables, and meat (especially pork), and they often use olive oil.

translations.source: Oúnjẹ alẹ́ tí ó gbajúgbajà pàápàá jùlọ ní àkókò yìí ni Pa amb Oil: búrẹ́dì pẹ̀lú olive oil, tòmátì, ati èyíkéyì ohun tí ẹnu ń jẹ́ bí i wàrà, ẹja tuna abbl.
translations.reference: A simple popular dinner, especially during the summer, is the Pa amb Oli: Bread with olive oil, tomato, and any available condiments such as cheese, tunafish, etc.
translations.hypothesis: The most popular pasta dish right now is Pa amb Oil: pasta with olive oil, tomatoes, and various toppings like tuna, vegetables, etc.

translations.source: Gbogbo ọ́rọ́ orúkọ pèlú ọ́rọ́ Sie fun ọ, nígbogbo ìgbà bẹ̀rẹ̀ pèlú lẹ́ta ńla, kò baa sẹ ní ààrin gbólohùn.
translations.reference: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.
translations.hypothesis: All names with the letter "S" begin with a capital letter, and this is always the case, regardless of the context.

translations.source: Ona to se patakilati fi mo iyato ninu awon oro ise ati oro oruko to n gba is.
translations.reference: This is an important way to distinguish between some verbs and objects.
translations.hypothesis: The road was blocked, causing a difference in the flow of traffic and the movement of people.

translations.source: A lè jiyan pe o ma n mú kí ìwé kíkà rọrùn si, ṣùgbọ́́n ìwé kika ṣòro tori Èyàn níláti wadi bóyá ilo ọ̀rọ̀ ìṣe àti ọ̀rọ̀ ìjúwe lọ́́nà tó fi ifiyesi ha.
translations.reference: It also arguably makes reading easier, though writing is somewhat complicated by the need to find out whether a verb or adjective is used in a substantivized form.
translations.hypothesis: While it might seem that technology makes reading easier, in reality, it can make reading more difficult because people are constantly distracted by notifications and other digital stimuli.

translations.source: Gbigbe oro jade fi be rorun pelu ede Itili nigba to je pe bi won se pe bee na ni won se ko
translations.reference: Pronunciation is relatively easy in Italian since most words are pronounced exactly how they are written
translations.hypothesis: It's easy to communicate in English because people generally say what they mean.

translations.source: Awon oro ti o se koko lati se akiyesi ni c ati g, nitori pipe won da le awon faweli wonyi.
translations.reference: The main letters to watch out for are c and g, since their pronunciation varies based on the following vowel.
translations.hypothesis: The most important things to pay attention to are 'c' and 'g', because their pronunciations can be tricky.

translations.source: Bákanáà, se àrídájú pé o pe r ati rr lọ́tọ́ọ̀tọ̀: caro túmọ̀ sí ọ̀wọ́n nígbàtí carro túmọ̀ sí kẹ̀kẹ́ ẹṣin.
translations.reference: Also, make sure to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, whereas carro means chariot.
translations.hypothesis: Finally, it's important to be clear and concise: say "car" when you mean "car," not "automobile" or "vehicle."

translations.source: Èdè Persia ni gírámà tó rọrùn díẹ̀ tó sì tún ní ìlànà jọjọ.
translations.reference: Persian has a relatively easy and mostly regular grammar.
translations.hypothesis: Persian is a relatively easy language to learn, and it also has a beautiful structure.

translations.source: Fun idi eyi, kika iwe girama yi yio fun ọ ni anfani lati mọ nipa girama Persian ati ki oriṣiriṣi gbolohun le ye ọ daada.
translations.reference: Therefore, reading this grammar primer would help you learn much about Persian grammar and understand phrases better.
translations.hypothesis: Therefore, reading this insightful book will give you the opportunity to learn about Persian literature and how various themes can resonate with you.

translations.source: Láìsí àní àní, bí o bá mọ èdè Róòmù, yí ó rọrùn fún ọ láti kọ́ èdè ilẹ̀ portugal.
translations.reference: Needless to say, if you know a Romance language, it will be easier for you to learn Portuguese.
translations.hypothesis: If you know the Romance languages, it will be relatively easy for you to learn the Portuguese language.

translations.source: Àmọ́ṣá, àwọn ènìyàn tó ma èdè ilẹ̀ Spain díẹ̀ lè tètè sọ wípé èdè ilẹ̀ Portugal súnmọ́ ra nítorínà kò nílò pé ènìyàn ń kọ́ ọ.
translations.reference: However, people who know a little Spanish may hastily conclude that Portuguese is close enough that it need not be studied separately.
translations.hypothesis: Interestingly, some people in Spain might argue that the Portuguese language is too similar to Spanish, and therefore, there's no need to learn it.

translations.source: Àwọn àkíyèsí ayé àtijó lọ́pòlọpọ̀ ìgbà kò ní ìwúlò lónìí, àti wípé wọn wà bi ilé ìkó iṣẹ́ ọnà sí tàbí àyè ikẹẹ̀kọ. .
translations.reference: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education.
translations.hypothesis: Many historical landmarks are now tourist attractions or serve as educational sites.

translations.source: Torípé ìṣòro ẹ̀gbin iná óyàtọ̀ sí bó ṣe wà lónìí, wọ́n ma n sábà wà ní ilu tàbí ọgbà ilé ìwé, o rọrùn láti débẹ̀ jú àwọn tí a kọ́ ní igbalode lọ.
translations.reference: As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times.
translations.hypothesis: Despite the challenges of modern life, it is still possible to find moments of peace and tranquility, whether in a bustling city or a quiet home. It is important to take time for ourselves and to connect with the things that bring us joy.

translations.source: Ọpọ̀ àwọn ẹ̀ro ìwòyẹ ìgbàlódẹ fún ìwádìí jẹ àwọn ohun ẹ̀lò títóbi jọjọ ní àwọn agbẹ̀gbẹ̀ ọ̀nà jiínjín to ni àwọn ọjú ọjọ́ dáradára.
translations.reference: Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.
translations.hypothesis: Many modern skincare products contain a variety of ingredients that are carefully combined to achieve specific results, often with a focus on improving the appearance of the skin.

translations.source: Hanami, tí í ṣe ìwò-cherry-tí-ó-rẹwà ti wà nínú àṣà àwọn Japan láti Sẹ́ńtúrì kẹjọ.
translations.reference: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.
translations.hypothesis: Hanami, the tradition of enjoying the beauty of cherry blossoms, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 17th century.

translations.source: Láti orílèèdè China ni èrò àtinúdá náà ti wá, níbi tí èso igi púlùmù ti jẹ́ òdòdó tí ó yááyì jùlọ.
translations.reference: The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice.
translations.hypothesis: This adorable puppy comes from China, a country known for its beautiful and fluffy poodles.

translations.source: Ní orílẹ̀èdè Japan, àwọn olórí nìkan ni ó má ń sayẹyẹ èso ṣẹ́ẹ́ẹ́rì fúnra ara wọn àtàwọn èèkàn nídí iṣẹ́ ọba mìíran nínú ìgbìmọ̀ ọba mìíràn.
translations.reference: In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
translations.hypothesis: In Japan, only the emperor can perform the traditional purification ritual for himself, while other members of the imperial family participate in a different ceremony within the imperial court.

translations.source: Àwọn ewéko máa ń rẹwà nígbà tí wọ́n bá wà ní ààyè wọn, fún ìdí èyí yẹra fún fífọwọ́ kan àwọn ewéko wọ̀nyí.
translations.reference: Plants look their best when in a natural environment, so resist the temptation to remove even "just one" specimen.
translations.hypothesis: Plants thrive when they are in their natural environment, and this is why it is important to consider the needs of these plants.

translations.source: Ti o ba lo gba specimeni nigba ti o ba lo be ogba ti won ti to, won maa le e kuro lai koko ba e soro.
translations.reference: If visiting a formally arranged garden, collecting "specimens" is also going to get you ejected, without discussion.
translations.hypothesis: If you go to collect the samples while the plants are still mature, they will be easier to remove without causing you any trouble.

translations.source: Singapore jẹ́ ibi tó ní àbò jùlọ láti wà ó sì rọrùn láti lọ kiri, o sì lè ra gbogbo ǹkan tí o bá dé ibẹ̀.
translations.reference: Singapore is generally an extremely safe place to be and very easy to navigate, and you can buy almost anything after arriving.
translations.hypothesis: Singapore is a very convenient place to visit, it's easy to get around, and you can find everything you need there.

translations.source: Ṣùgbọ́n tí wọ́n bá fi é sí “ilẹ̀ oru òkè” ni apá arewa ikwetọ̀ oru (nígbà gbogbo) àti òrùn tóle (nígbà tí ọjọ́ bá dá, kìí fibẹ́ wáyé) lo ma bá fàá.
translations.reference: But being placed in the "high tropics" just a few degrees north of equator you will need to deal with both heat (always) and strong sun (when the sky is clear, more rarely).
translations.hypothesis: However, the "high pressure system" in the northern hemisphere and the "ridge" (which typically brings clear skies, but can sometimes cause rain) are the main factors that influence the weather.

translations.source: Àwọn ọkọ́ akérò díẹ̀ tó ń lọ sí àríwá sí Hebron, ìsìnkú náà wáyé ní Biblical patriarch Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, àti àwọn ìyàwó wọn.
translations.reference: There are also a few buses going north to Hebron, the traditional burial place of the Biblical patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and their wives.
translations.hypothesis: A few buses heading north to Hebron were involved in an incident that reportedly occurred near the biblical figures of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, along with their wives.

translations.source: Yẹ̀wò bóya boosi to fẹ́ wọ̀ ma dé Hebroni kii ṣe ilẹ̀ Ju itosi ibe Kiriyati Arba.
translations.reference: Check that the bus you are thinking of taking goes into Hebron and not just to the nearby Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.
translations.hypothesis: I wonder if the person who wants to go to Hebron is aware that it is a city in the State of Judea, Israel.

translations.source: Àwọn ojú ọ̀nà omi abẹ́lé lè jẹ́ àkolé tó dára láti gbé ìsinmi lẹ́nu iṣẹ́ lé lórí.
translations.reference: Inland waterways can be a good theme to base a holiday around.
translations.hypothesis: Water fountains can be a great way to add a touch of elegance to an office space.

translations.source: Fún àpẹrẹ sísé àbẹ̀wò sí ilé ńlá iLoire, àfonífojì ti Rhine àbí wíwá ọkọ̀ ojú omi kekeré sí àwọn ibi tí a nífẹ̀ẹ́ sí ní Danube àbí wiwa ọkọ̀ ojú omi kọjá Erie Canal.
translations.reference: For example visiting castles in the Loire Valley, the Rhine valley or taking a cruise to interesting cites on the Danube or boating along the Erie Canal.
translations.hypothesis: For example, consider a cruise to the Loire Valley, a Rhine River cruise, or a small boat trip to popular destinations on the Danube, or a boat tour along the Erie Canal.

translations.source: Wọ́n tún sàlàyé ọ̀nà fún pípọ́n òkè àti ojú ipa ìyípo.
translations.reference: They also define routes for popular hiking and cycling trails.
translations.hypothesis: They also provided instructions for the installation of the satellite dish and the connection of the cable.

translations.source: Kẹ́rẹ́sìmẹsì jẹ́ ọ̀kan lára ìsinmi tó se pàtàkì jùlọ nínú ẹ̀sìn Krìstẹ́nì, ó sì tún jẹ́ àjọyọ ọjọ́ ìbí Jẹ́sù.
translations.reference: Christmas is one of the most important holidays of Christianity, and is celebrated as the birthday of Jesus.
translations.hypothesis: Christmas is one of the most important holidays in Christianity, and it is also a celebration of the birth of Jesus.

translations.source: Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ìṣe tó yí ìsinmi ká ní àwọn tí kìí ṣe onígbàgbọ́ láwọn orílẹ̀èdè àwọn ọmọlẹ́yìn Kristi àti àwọn tí kì í ṣe ọmọlẹ́yìn Kristi lágbàáyé.
translations.reference: Many of the traditions surrounding the holiday have been adopted also by non-believers in Christian countries and non-Christians around the world.
translations.hypothesis: Many of the events that led to the decline involved both Christians and non-Christians around the world.

translations.source: Àṣà kan wà láti se àìsùn ní alẹ́ ọjọ́ àj.
translations.reference: There's a tradition to pass the Easter night awake at some exposed point to see the sunrise.
translations.hypothesis: There is a tradition of observing a moment of silence in the evening.

translations.source: Àlàyé ẹ̀kọ́ inú ẹ̀sin kìrìsìtẹ́nì mẹ̀rin ló wà fún ìse yìí, àmọ́ ó lẹ̀ jẹ́ àkókò tí ẹ̀sin kìrìsìtẹ́nì ò tí ì dé àti ìrúbọ ìbímọ.
translations.reference: There are of course Christian theological explanations for this tradition, but it may well be a pre-Christian Spring and Fertility ritual.
translations.hypothesis: The educational aspect of this Christian ministry is significant, as it provides a foundation for faith and promotes family values.

translations.source: Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ṣọ́ọ̀ọì ni wọn má a ń ṣe ìṣọ́-òru ọdún àjíǹde ni alẹ́ ọjọ́ Àbámẹ̀ta òpin ọ̀sẹ̀ àjíǹde. Ní ọ̀gànjọ́ òru, àwọn ọmọ ìjọ a má a fò fún ayọ̀ nítorí àjíǹde Krístì.
translations.reference: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.
translations.hypothesis: Many churches hold special services on Christmas Eve, the evening before Christmas Day. During these services, the congregation often celebrates the birth of Christ with joy and reverence.

translations.source: Wiwẹ, fifo loju ofurufu ati fifo loju omi ni ọna ti gbogbo ẹranko ti o koko de awọn irukusu gba debi.
translations.reference: All animals that originally arrived in the islands came here either by swimming, flying or floating.
translations.hypothesis: Unfortunately, both aerial and aquatic transportation methods are ways in which all kinds of cargo can be delivered.

translations.source: Látàrí ọ̀nà jínjìn láti kọ́ńtìnẹ̀ntì, àwọn ẹranko abìyẹ́ kò lè bá ìrìnàjò,èyí tó mún kí ìjàpá ńlá jẹ́ ẹranko ìwá oúnjẹ nínú Galapagos.
translations.reference: Due to the long distance from the continent mammals were unable to make the journey making the giant tortoise the primary grazing animal in the Galapagos.
translations.hypothesis: Due to the vast distance from the mainland, these animals evolved in isolation, which led to the unique wildlife found on the Galapagos Islands.

translations.source: Látìgbà tí ọmọnìyàn ti dé sí Galapagos, ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ẹranko abìyẹ́ ni wọ́n ti se àfihàn nínú èyí tí àwọn ewúrẹ́, ẹṣin, màálù, eku, ológìnní, àti àwọn ajá.
translations.reference: Since the arrival of man to the Galapagos, many mammals have been introduced including goats, horses, cows, rats, cats and dogs.
translations.hypothesis: Since the arrival of humans in the Galapagos, many native species have been threatened, including birds, reptiles, mammals, insects, plants, and amphibians.

translations.source: Bí o bá se àbẹ̀wò sí agbègbè Arctic tàbí Antarctic nínú otútù, wà á ní ìrírí alẹ́ pólà, èyí tó túmọ̀ sí wípé òòrùn kì í yọ lókè ọ̀rún.
translations.reference: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon.
translations.hypothesis: If you were to travel to the Arctic or Antarctic regions during the winter, you would experience a phenomenon called the polar night, which means that the sun does not rise above the horizon.

translations.source: Eyi fu ni ni aye to dara lati ri ati ri Aurora borealis, nitori pe oju orun maa dudu ni gbogbo igba.
translations.reference: This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock.
translations.hypothesis: This is a great place to see the Aurora Borealis because the sky is often clear.

translations.source: Bí àdúgbò náà ti ní èrò, àti tí iná sì pọ̀, torí náà kìí sí ìṣòro ní ọ̀pọ̀ ìgbà, o tún máa lè gbádùn ìràwọ̀.
translations.reference: As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.
translations.hypothesis: When the weather is hot and humid, and there is little wind, it can be very uncomfortable. However, there are ways to stay cool and comfortable.

translations.source: Aṣa ibi iṣẹ Japanisi kun fu oye ati iṣedeede ju nkan to ti mọ awọn ara Oke Okun lar.
translations.reference: Japanese work culture is more hierarchical and formal that what Westerners may be used to.
translations.hypothesis: Japanese workplace culture is known for its formality and strict adherence to rules, which can be quite different from what people from Western cultures are used to.

translations.source: Súùtù jẹ́ aṣọ okoòwò àwọn alájọse sì ma ń fi orúkọ ìdílé tàbí àpèlé iṣẹ́ perawọn.
translations.reference: Suits are standard business attire, and coworkers call each other by their family names or by job titles.
translations.hypothesis: Suits are formal attire often worn by business professionals and are typically identified by a family name or company name.

translations.source: Ìbáṣepsọ̀ ní ibi iṣẹ́ ṣe pàtàkì, títẹnumọ́ àkitiyan ẹgbẹ́ ju kí wọ́n ma gboríyín ǹkan tí oníkálùkù ti gbé ṣe.
translations.reference: Workplace harmony is crucial, emphasizing group effort rather than praising individual accomplishments.
translations.hypothesis: Teamwork is crucial in the workplace, often leading to better results than individual efforts alone.

translations.source: Ó yé kí àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ma gba ìfọwọ́sí láti ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn ọ̀gá wọn fún ìpinu tí wọ́n bá ṣe, ó sì yẹ kí wọ́n gbọ́nràn sí àwọn ọ̀gá wọn lẹ́nu láì bèrè ìbéèrè.
translations.reference: Workers must often get their superiors' approval for any decisions they make, and are expected to obey their superiors' instructions without question.
translations.hypothesis: Employees should accept praise from their superiors for good work, and they should also respond to their superiors with respect and without being overly familiar.
